pasai oun hai geneai apo abraam heos dauid geneai dekatessares kai apo dauid heos tes metoikesias babulonos geneai dekatessares kai apo tes metoikesias babulonos heos tou christou geneai dekatessares
tou de iesou christou he genesis houtos en mnesteutheises tes metros autou marias to ioseph prin e sunelthein autous heurethe en gastri echousa ek pneumatos hagiou
ioseph de ho aner autes dikaios on kai me thelon auten deigmatisai eboulethe lathra apolusai auten
tauta de autou enthumethentos idou anelos kuriou kat onar ephane auto legon ioseph huios dauid me phobethes paralabein marian ten gunaika sou to gar en aute gennethen ek pneumatos estin hagiou
texetai de huion kai kaleseis to onoma autou iesoun autos gar sosei ton laon autou apo ton hamartion auton
touto de holon gegonen hina plerothe to hrethen hupo kuriou dia tou prophetou legontos
idou he parthenos en gastri hexei kai texetai huion kai kalesousin to onoma autou emmanouel ho estin methermeneuomenon meth hemon ho theos
egertheis de ho ioseph apo tou hupnou epoiesen hos prosetaxen auto ho anelos kuriou kai parelaben ten gunaika autou
kai ouk eginosken auten heos hou eteken huion kai ekalesen to onoma autou iesoun
tou de iesou gennethentos en bethleem tes ioudaias en hemerais herodou tou basileos idou magoi apo anatolon paregenonto eis hierosoluma
legontes pou estin ho techtheis basileus ton ioudaion eidomen gar autou ton astera en te anatole kai elthomen proskunesai auto
akousas de ho basileus herodes etarachthe kai pasa hierosoluma met autou
kai sunagagon pantas tous archiereis kai grammateis tou laou epunthaneto par auton pou ho christos gennatai
hoi de eipan auto en bethleem tes ioudaias houtos gar gegraptai dia tou prophetou
kai su bethleem ge iouda oudamos elachiste ei en tois hegemosin iouda ek sou gar exeleusetai hegoumenos hostis poimanei ton laon mou ton israel
tote herodes lathra kalesas tous magous ekribosen par auton ton chronon tou phainomenou asteros
kai pempsas autous eis bethleem eipen poreuthentes exetasate akribos peri tou paidiou epan de heurete apaneilate moi hopos kago elthon proskuneso auto
hoi de akousantes tou basileos eporeuthesan kai idou ho aster hon eidon en te anatole proegen autous heos elthon estathe epano hou en to paidion
idontes de ton astera echaresan charan megalen sphodra
kai elthontes eis ten oikian eidon to paidion meta marias tes metros autou kai pesontes prosekunesan auto kai anoixantes tous thesaurous auton prosenenkan auto dora chruson kai libanon kai smurnan
kai chrematisthentes kat onar me anakampsai pros heroden di alles hodou anechoresan eis ten choran auton

anachoresanton de auton idou anelos kuriou phainetai kat onar to ioseph legon egertheis paralabe to paidion kai ten metera autou kai pheuge eis aigupton kai isthi ekei heos an eipo soi mellei gar herodes zetein to paidion tou apolesai auto
ho de egertheis parelaben to paidion kai ten metera autou nuktos kai anechoresen eis aigupton
kai en ekei heos tes teleutes herodou hina plerothe to hrethen hupo kuriou dia tou prophetou legontos ex aiguptou ekalesa ton huion mou

tote herodes idon hoti enepaichthe hupo ton magon ethumothe lian kai aposteilas aneilen pantas tous paidas tous en bethleem kai en pasi tois horiois autes apo dietous kai katotero kata ton chronon hon ekribosen para ton magon

phone en hrama ekousthe klauthmos kai odurmos polus hrachel klaiousa ta tekna autes kai ouk ethelen paraklethenai hoti ouk eisin
teleutesantos de tou herodou idou anelos kuriou phainetai kat onar to ioseph en aigupto
legon egertheis paralabe to paidion kai ten metera autou kai poreuou eis gen israel tethnekasin gar hoi zetountes ten psuchen tou paidiou
ho de egertheis parelaben to paidion kai ten metera autou kai eiselthen eis gen israel
akousas de hoti archelaos basileuei tes ioudaias anti tou patros autou herodou ephobethe ekei apelthein chrematistheis de kat onar anechoresen eis ta mere tes galilaias
kai elthon katokesen eis polin legomenen nazaret hopos plerothe to hrethen dia ton propheton hoti nazoraios klethesetai
en de tais hemerais ekeinais paraginetai ioannes ho baptistes kerusson en te eremo tes ioudaias
kai legon metanoeite eniken gar he basileia ton ouranon
houtos gar estin ho hretheis dia esaiou tou prophetou legontos phone boontos en te eremo hetoimasate ten hodon kuriou eutheias poieite tas tribous autou
autos de ho ioannes eichen to enduma autou apo trichon kamelou kai zonen dermatinen peri ten osphun autou he de trophe en autou akrides kai meli agrion
tote exeporeueto pros auton hierosoluma kai pasa he ioudaia kai pasa he perichoros tou iordanou
kai ebaptizonto en to iordane potamo hup autou exomologoumenoi tas hamartias auton
idon de pollous ton pharisaion kai saddoukaion erchomenous epi to baptisma autou eipen autois gennemata echidnon tis hupedeixen humin phugein apo tes mellouses orges
poiesate oun karpon axion tes metanoias
kai me doxete legein en heautois patera echomen ton abraam lego gar humin hoti dunatai ho theos ek ton lithon touton egeirai tekna to abraam
ede de he axine pros ten hrizan ton dendron keitai pan oun dendron me poioun karpon kalon ekkoptetai kai eis pur balletai
ego men humas baptizo en hudati eis metanoian ho de opiso mou erchomenos ischuroteros mou estin hou ouk eimi hikanos ta hupodemata bastasai autos humas baptisei en pneumati hagio kai puri
hou to ptuon en te cheiri autou kai diakathariei ten halona autou kai sunaxei ton siton autou eis ten apotheken to de achuron katakausei puri asbesto
tote paraginetai ho iesous apo tes galilaias epi ton iordanen pros ton ioannen tou baptisthenai hup autou
ho de ioannes diekoluen auton legon ego chreian echo hupo sou baptisthenai kai su erche pros me
apokritheis de ho iesous eipen pros auton aphes arti houtos gar prepon estin hemin plerosai pasan dikaiosunen tote aphiesin auton
baptistheis de ho iesous euthus anebe apo tou hudatos kai idou eneochthesan auto hoi ouranoi kai eiden to pneuma tou theou katabainon hosei peristeran kai erchomenon ep auton
kai idou phone ek ton ouranon legousa houtos estin ho huios mou ho agapetos en ho eudokesa
tote ho iesous anechthe eis ten eremon hupo tou pneumatos peirasthenai hupo tou diabolou
kai nesteusas hemeras tesserakonta kai nuktas tesserakonta husteron epeinasen
kai proselthon ho peirazon eipen auto ei huios ei tou theou eipe hina hoi lithoi houtoi artoi genontai
ho de apokritheis eipen gegraptai ouk ep arto mono zesetai ho anthropos all epi panti hremati ekporeuomeno dia stomatos theou
tote paralambanei auton ho diabolos eis ten hagian polin kai estesen auton epi to pterugion tou hierou
kai legei auto ei huios ei tou theou bale seauton kato gegraptai gar hoti tois anelois autou enteleitai peri sou kai epi cheiron arousin se mepote proskopses pros lithon ton poda sou
ephe auto ho iesous palin gegraptai ouk ekpeiraseis kurion ton theon sou

tote legei auto ho iesous hupage satana gegraptai gar kurion ton theon sou proskuneseis kai auto mono latreuseis

ego de lego humin hoti pas ho blepon gunaika pros to epithumesai auten ede emoicheusen auten en te kardia autou

palin ekousate hoti errethe tois archaiois ouk epiorkeseis apodoseis de to kurio tous horkous sou
ego de lego humin me omosai holos mete en to ourano hoti thronos estin tou theou
mete en te ge hoti hupopodion estin ton podon autou mete eis hierosoluma hoti polis estin tou megalou basileos

kai ekteinas ten cheira autou epi tous mathetas autou eipen idou he meter mou kai hoi adelphoi mou
hostis gar an poiese to thelema tou patros mou tou en ouranois autos mou adelphos kai adelphe kai meter estin
en te hemera ekeine exelthon ho iesous tes oikias ekatheto para ten thalassan
kai sunechthesan pros auton ochloi polloi hoste auton eis ploion embanta kathesthai kai pas ho ochlos epi ton aigialon heistekei
kai elalesen autois polla en parabolais legon idou exelthen ho speiron tou speirein
kai en to speirein auton ha men epesen para ten hodon kai elthonta ta peteina katephagen auta
alla de epesen epi ta petrode hopou ouk eichen gen pollen kai eutheos exaneteilen dia to me echein bathos ges
heliou de anateilantos ekaumatisthe kai dia to me echein hrizan exeranthe
alla de epesen epi tas akanthas kai anebesan hai akanthai kai epnixan auta
alla de epesen epi ten gen ten kalen kai edidou karpon ho men hekaton ho de hexekonta ho de triakonta
ho echon ota akoueto
kai proselthontes hoi mathetai eipan auto dia ti en parabolais laleis autois
ho de apokritheis eipen autois hoti humin dedotai gnonai ta musteria tes basileias ton ouranon ekeinois de ou dedotai
hostis gar echei dothesetai auto kai perisseuthesetai hostis de ouk echei kai ho echei arthesetai ap autou
dia touto en parabolais autois lalo hoti blepontes ou blepousin kai akouontes ouk akouousin oude suniousin
kai anapleroutai autois he propheteia esaiou he legousa akoe akousete kai ou me sunete kai blepontes blepsete kai ou me idete

epachunthe gar he kardia tou laou toutou kai tois osin bareos ekousan kai tous ophthalmous auton ekammusan mepote idosin tois ophthalmois kai tois osin akousosin kai te kardia sunosin kai epistrepsosin kai iasomai autous
humon de makarioi hoi ophthalmoi hoti blepousin kai ta ota humon hoti akouousin
amen gar lego humin hoti polloi prophetai kai dikaioi epethumesan idein ha blepete kai ouk eidan kai akousai ha akouete kai ouk ekousan
humeis oun akousate ten parabolen tou speirantos
pantos akouontos ton logon tes basileias kai me sunientos erchetai ho poneros kai harpazei to esparmenon en te kardia autou houtos estin ho para ten hodon spareis
ho de epi ta petrode spareis houtos estin ho ton logon akouon kai euthus meta charas lambanon auton
ouk echei de hrizan en heauto alla proskairos estin genomenes de thlipseos e diogmou dia ton logon euthus skandalizetai
ho de eis tas akanthas spareis houtos estin ho ton logon akouon kai he merimna tou aionos kai he apate tou ploutou sumpnigei ton logon kai akarpos ginetai
ho de epi ten kalen gen spareis houtos estin ho ton logon akouon kai sunieis hos de karpophorei kai poiei ho men hekaton ho de hexekonta ho de triakonta
allen parabolen paretheken autois legon homoiothe he basileia ton ouranon anthropo speiranti kalon sperma en to agro autou
en de to katheudein tous anthropous elthen autou ho echthros kai epespeiren zizania ana meson tou sitou kai apelthen
hote de eblastesen ho chortos kai karpon epoiesen tote ephane kai ta zizania
proselthontes de hoi douloi tou oikodespotou eipon auto kurie ouchi kalon sperma espeiras en to so agro pothen oun echei zizania
ho de ephe autois echthros anthropos touto epoiesen hoi de douloi legousin auto theleis oun apelthontes sullexomen auta
ho de phesin ou mepote sullegontes ta zizania ekrizosete hama autois ton siton

aphete sunauxanesthai amphotera heos tou therismou kai en kairo tou therismou ero tois theristais sullexate proton ta zizania kai desate auta eis desmas pros to katakausai auta ton de siton sunagagete eis ten apotheken mou
allen parabolen paretheken autois legon homoia estin he basileia ton ouranon kokko sinapeos hon labon anthropos espeiren en to agro autou
ho mikroteron men estin panton ton spermaton hotan de auxethe meizon ton lachanon estin kai ginetai dendron hoste elthein ta peteina tou ouranou kai kataskenoun en tois kladois autou
allen parabolen elalesen autois homoia estin he basileia ton ouranon zume hen labousa gune enekrupsen eis aleurou sata tria heos hou ezumothe holon
tauta panta elalesen ho iesous en parabolais tois ochlois kai choris paraboles ouden elalei autois
hopos plerothe to hrethen dia tou prophetou legontos anoixo en parabolais to stoma mou ereuxomai kekrummena apo kataboles kosmou
tote apheis tous ochlous elthen eis ten oikian kai proselthon auto hoi mathetai autou legontes diasapheson hemin ten parabolen ton zizanion tou agrou
ho de apokritheis eipen ho speiron to kalon sperma estin ho huios tou anthropou
ho de agros estin ho kosmos to de kalon sperma houtoi eisin hoi huioi tes basileias ta de zizania eisin hoi huioi tou ponerou
ho de echthros ho speiras auta estin ho diabolos ho de therismos sunteleia aionos estin hoi de theristai aneloi eisin
hosper oun sullegetai ta zizania kai puri katakaietai houtos estai en te sunteleia tou aionos
apostelei ho huios tou anthropou tous anelous autou kai sullexousin ek tes basileias autou panta ta skandala kai tous poiountas ten anomian
kai balousin autous eis ten kaminon tou puros ekei estai ho klauthmos kai ho brugmos ton odonton
tote hoi dikaioi eklampsousin hos ho helios en te basileia tou patros auton ho echon ota akoueto
homoia estin he basileia ton ouranon thesauro kekrummeno en to agro hon heuron anthropos ekrupsen kai apo tes charas autou hupagei kai polei panta hosa echei kai agorazei ton agron ekeinon
palin homoia estin he basileia ton ouranon anthropo emporo zetounti kalous margaritas
heuron de hena polutimon margariten apelthon pepraken panta hosa eichen kai egorasen auton
palin homoia estin he basileia ton ouranon sagene bletheise eis ten thalassan kai ek pantos genous sunagagouse
hen hote eplerothe anabibasantes epi ton aigialon kai kathisantes sunelexan ta kala eis ane ta de sapra exo ebalon
houtos estai en te sunteleia tou aionos exeleusontai hoi aneloi kai aphoriousin tous ponerous ek mesou ton dikaion
kai balousin autous eis ten kaminon tou puros ekei estai ho klauthmos kai ho brugmos ton odonton
sunekate tauta panta legousin auto nai
ho de eipen autois dia touto pas grammateus matheteutheis te basileia ton ouranon homoios estin anthropo oikodespote hostis ekballei ek tou thesaurou autou kaina kai palaia
kai egeneto hote etelesen ho iesous tas parabolas tautas meteren ekeithen
kai elthon eis ten patrida autou edidasken autous en te sunagoge auton hoste ekplessesthai autous kai legein pothen touto he sophia haute kai hai dunameis
ouch houtos estin ho tou tektonos huios ouch he meter autou legetai mariam kai hoi adelphoi autou iakobos kai ioseph kai simon kai ioudas
kai hai adelphai autou ouchi pasai pros hemas eisin pothen oun touto tauta panta
kai eskandalizonto en auto ho de iesous eipen autois ouk estin prophetes atimos ei me en te patridi kai en te oikia autou
kai ouk epoiesen ekei dunameis pollas dia ten apistian auton
en ekeino to kairo ekousen herodes ho tetraarches ten akoen iesou
kai eipen tois paisin autou houtos estin ioannes ho baptistes autos egerthe apo ton nekron kai dia touto hai dunameis energousin en auto
ho gar herodes kratesas ton ioannen edesen auton kai en phulake apetheto dia herodiada ten gunaika philippou tou adelphou autou
elegen gar ho ioannes auto ouk exestin soi echein auten
kai thelon auton apokteinai ephobethe ton ochlon hoti hos propheten auton eichon
genesiois de genomenois tou herodou orchesato he thugater tes herodiados en to meso kai eresen to herode
hothen meth horkou homologesen aute dounai ho ean aitesetai
he de probibastheisa hupo tes metros autes dos moi phesin hode epi pinaki ten kephalen ioannou tou baptistou
kai lupetheis ho basileus dia tous horkous kai tous sunanakeimenous ekeleusen dothenai
kai pempsas apekephalisen ton ioannen en te phulake
kai enechthe he kephale autou epi pinaki kai edothe to korasio kai enenken te metri autes
kai proselthontes hoi mathetai autou eran to ptoma kai ethapsan auton kai elthontes apeneilan to iesou
akousas de ho iesous anechoresen ekeithen en ploio eis eremon topon kat idian kai akousantes hoi ochloi ekolouthesan auto peze apo ton poleon
kai exelthon eiden polun ochlon kai esplanchnisthe ep autois kai etherapeusen tous arrostous auton
opsias de genomenes proselthon auto hoi mathetai legontes eremos estin ho topos kai he hora ede parelthen apoluson tous ochlous hina apelthontes eis tas komas agorasosin heautois bromata
ho de iesous eipen autois ou chreian echousin apelthein dote autois humeis phagein
hoi de legousin auto ouk echomen hode ei me pente artous kai duo ichthuas
ho de eipen pherete moi hode autous

kai keleusas tous ochlous anaklithenai epi tou chortou labon tous pente artous kai tous duo ichthuas anablepsas eis ton ouranon eulogesen kai klasas edoken tois mathetais tous artous hoi de mathetai tois ochlois
kai ephagon pantes kai echortasthesan kai eran to perisseuon ton klasmaton dodeka kophinous plereis

to de ploion ede stadious pollous apo tes ges apeichen basanizomenon hupo ton kumaton en gar enantios ho anemos
tetarte de phulake tes nuktos elthen pros autous peripaton epi ten thalassan
hoi de mathetai idontes auton epi tes thalasses peripatounta etarachthesan legontes hoti phantasma estin kai apo tou phobou ekraxan
euthus de elalesen ho iesous autois legon tharseite ego eimi me phobeisthe
apokritheis de auto ho petros eipen kurie ei su ei keleuson me elthein pros se epi ta hudata
ho de eipen elthe kai katabas apo tou ploiou ho petros periepatesen epi ta hudata kai elthen pros ton iesoun
blepon de ton anemon ischuron ephobethe kai arxamenos katapontizesthai ekraxen legon kurie soson me
eutheos de ho iesous ekteinas ten cheira epelabeto autou kai legei auto oligopiste eis ti edistasas
kai anabanton auton eis to ploion ekopasen ho anemos
hoi de en to ploio prosekunesan auto legontes alethos theou huios ei
kai diaperasantes elthon epi ten gen eis gennesaret
kai epignontes auton hoi andres tou topou ekeinou apesteilan eis holen ten perichoron ekeinen kai prosenenkan auto pantas tous kakos echontas
kai parekaloun auton hina monon hapsontai tou kraspedou tou himatiou autou kai hosoi hepsanto diesothesan
tote proserchontai to iesou apo hierosolumon pharisaioi kai grammateis legontes
dia ti hoi mathetai sou parabainousin ten paradosin ton presbuteron ou gar niptontai tas cheiras auton hotan arton esthiosin
ho de apokritheis eipen autois dia ti kai humeis parabainete ten entolen tou theou dia ten paradosin humon
ho gar theos eipen tima ton patera kai ten metera kai ho kakologon patera e metera thanato teleutato
humeis de legete hos an eipe to patri e te metri doron ho ean ex emou ophelethes
ou me timesei ton patera autou kai ekurosate ton logon tou theou dia ten paradosin humon
hupokritai kalos epropheteusen peri humon esaias legon
ho laos houtos tois cheilesin me tima he de kardia auton porro apechei ap emou
maten de sebontai me didaskontes didaskalias entalmata anthropon
kai proskalesamenos ton ochlon eipen autois akouete kai suniete
ou to eiserchomenon eis to stoma koinoi ton anthropon alla to ekporeuomenon ek tou stomatos touto koinoi ton anthropon
tote proselthontes hoi mathetai legousin auto oidas hoti hoi pharisaioi akousantes ton logon eskandalisthesan
ho de apokritheis eipen pasa phuteia hen ouk ephuteusen ho pater mou ho ouranios ekrizothesetai
aphete autous tuphloi eisin hodegoi tuphlon tuphlos de tuphlon ean hodege amphoteroi eis bothunon pesountai
apokritheis de ho petros eipen auto phrason hemin ten parabolen tauten
ho de eipen akmen kai humeis asunetoi este
ou noeite hoti pan to eisporeuomenon eis to stoma eis ten koilian chorei kai eis aphedrona ekballetai
ta de ekporeuomena ek tou stomatos ek tes kardias exerchetai kakeina koinoi ton anthropon

tauta estin ta koinounta ton anthropon to de aniptois chersin phagein ou koinoi ton anthropon

ho de ouk apekrithe aute logon kai proselthontes hoi mathetai autou erotoun auton legontes apoluson auten hoti krazei opisthen hemon
ho de apokritheis eipen ouk apestalen ei me eis ta probata ta apololota oikou israel
he de elthousa prosekunei auto legousa kurie boethei moi
ho de apokritheis eipen ouk estin kalon labein ton arton ton teknon kai balein tois kunariois
he de eipen nai kurie kai gar ta kunaria esthiei apo ton psichion ton piptonton apo tes trapezes ton kurion auton
tote apokritheis ho iesous eipen aute o gunai megale sou he pistis genetheto soi hos theleis kai iathe he thugater autes apo tes horas ekeines

tote diesteilato tois mathetais hina medeni eiposin hoti autos estin ho christos

ti gar ophelethesetai anthropos ean ton kosmon holon kerdese ten de psuchen autou zemiothe e ti dosei anthropos antallagma tes psuches autou

kai eperotesan auton hoi mathetai legontes ti oun hoi grammateis legousin hoti elian dei elthein proton
ho de apokritheis eipen elias men erchetai kai apokatastesei panta
lego de humin hoti elias ede elthen kai ouk epegnosan auton alla epoiesan en auto hosa ethelesan houtos kai ho huios tou anthropou mellei paschein hup auton
tote sunekan hoi mathetai hoti peri ioannou tou baptistou eipen autois
kai elthonton pros ton ochlon proselthen auto anthropos gonupeton auton

apokritheis de ho iesous eipen o genea apistos kai diestrammene heos pote meth humon esomai heos pote anexomai humon pherete moi auton hode
kai epetimesen auto ho iesous kai exelthen ap autou to daimonion kai etherapeuthe ho pais apo tes horas ekeines
tote proselthontes hoi mathetai to iesou kat idian eipon dia ti hemeis ouk edunethemen ekbalein auto
ho de legei autois dia ten oligopistian humon amen gar lego humin ean echete pistin hos kokkon sinapeos ereite to orei touto metaba enthen ekei kai metabesetai kai ouden adunatesei humin
sustrephomenon de auton en te galilaia eipen autois ho iesous mellei ho huios tou anthropou paradidosthai eis cheiras anthropon
kai apoktenousin auton kai te trite hemera egerthesetai kai elupethesan sphodra
elthonton de auton eis kapharnaoum proselthon hoi ta didrachma lambanontes to petro kai eipan ho didaskalos humon ou telei ta didrachma
legei nai kai elthonta eis ten oikian proephthasen auton ho iesous legon ti soi dokei simon hoi basileis tes ges apo tinon lambanousin tele e kenson apo ton huion auton e apo ton allotrion
eipontos de apo ton allotrion ephe auto ho iesous ara ge eleutheroi eisin hoi huioi
hina de me skandalisomen autous poreutheis eis thalassan bale ankistron kai ton anabanta proton ichthun aron kai anoixas to stoma autou heureseis statera ekeinon labon dos autois anti emou kai sou
en ekeine te hora proselthon hoi mathetai to iesou legontes tis ara meizon estin en te basileia ton ouranon
kai proskalesamenos paidion estesen auto en meso auton
kai eipen amen lego humin ean me straphete kai genesthe hos ta paidia ou me eiselthete eis ten basileian ton ouranon
hostis oun tapeinosei heauton hos to paidion touto houtos estin ho meizon en te basileia ton ouranon
kai hos ean dexetai hen paidion toiouto epi to onomati mou eme dechetai
hos d an skandalise hena ton mikron touton ton pisteuonton eis eme sumpherei auto hina kremasthe mulos onikos peri ton trachelon autou kai katapontisthe en to pelagei tes thalasses
ouai to kosmo apo ton skandalon ananke gar elthein ta skandala plen ouai to anthropo di hou to skandalon erchetai

ei de he cheir sou e ho pous sou skandalizei se ekkopson auton kai bale apo sou kalon soi estin eiselthein eis ten zoen kullon e cholon e duo cheiras e duo podas echonta blethenai eis to pur to aionion
kai ei ho ophthalmos sou skandalizei se exele auton kai bale apo sou kalon soi estin monophthalmon eis ten zoen eiselthein e duo ophthalmous echonta blethenai eis ten geennan tou puros
horate me kataphronesete henos ton mikron touton lego gar humin hoti hoi aneloi auton en ouranois dia pantos blepousi to prosopon tou patros mou tou en ouranois
ti humin dokei ean genetai tini anthropo hekaton probata kai planethe hen ex auton ouchi aphesei ta enenekonta ennea epi ta ore kai poreutheis zetei to planomenon
kai ean genetai heurein auto amen lego humin hoti chairei ep auto mallon e epi tois enenekonta ennea tois me peplanemenois
houtos ouk estin thelema emprosthen tou patros humon tou en ouranois hina apoletai hen ton mikron touton
ean de hamartese eis se ho adelphos sou hupage elegxon auton metaxu sou kai autou monou ean sou akouse ekerdesas ton adelphon sou
ean de me akouse paralabe meta sou eti hena e duo hina epi stomatos duo marturon e trion stathe pan hrema
ean de parakouse auton eipe te ekklesia ean de kai tes ekklesias parakouse esto soi hosper ho ethnikos kai ho telones
amen lego humin hosa ean desete epi tes ges estai dedemena en ourano kai hosa ean lusete epi tes ges estai lelumena en ourano
palin amen lego humin hoti ean duo sumphonesosin ex humon epi tes ges peri pantos pragmatos hou ean aitesontai genesetai autois para tou patros mou tou en ouranois
hou gar eisin duo e treis sunegmenoi eis to emon onoma ekei eimi en meso auton
tote proselthon ho petros eipen auto kurie posakis hamartesei eis eme ho adelphos mou kai apheso auto heos heptakis
legei auto ho iesous ou lego soi heos heptakis alla heos hebdomekontakis hepta
dia touto homoiothe he basileia ton ouranon anthropo basilei hos ethelesen sunarai logon meta ton doulon autou
arxamenou de autou sunairein prosenechthe auto heis opheiletes murion talanton
me echontos de autou apodounai ekeleusen auton ho kurios prathenai kai ten gunaika kai ta tekna kai panta hosa echei kai apodothenai
peson oun ho doulos prosekunei auto legon makrothumeson ep emoi kai panta apodoso soi
splanchnistheis de ho kurios tou doulou ekeinou apelusen auton kai to daneion apheken auto
exelthon de ho doulos ekeinos heuren hena ton sundoulon autou hos opheilen auto hekaton denaria kai kratesas auton epnigen legon apodos ei ti opheileis
peson oun ho sundoulos autou parekalei auton legon makrothumeson ep emoi kai apodoso soi
ho de ouk ethelen alla apelthon ebalen auton eis phulaken heos apodo to opheilomenon
idontes oun hoi sundouloi autou ta genomena elupethesan sphodra kai elthontes diesaphesan to kurio heauton panta ta genomena
tote proskalesamenos auton ho kurios autou legei auto doule ponere pasan ten opheilen ekeinen apheka soi epei parekalesas me
ouk edei kai se eleesai ton sundoulon sou hos kago se eleesa
kai orgistheis ho kurios autou paredoken auton tois basanistais heos hou apodo pan to opheilomenon
houtos kai ho pater mou ho ouranios poiesei humin ean me aphete hekastos to adelpho autou apo ton kardion humon
kai egeneto hote etelesen ho iesous tous logous toutous meteren apo tes galilaias kai elthen eis ta horia tes ioudaias peran tou iordanou
kai ekolouthesan auto ochloi polloi kai etherapeusen autous ekei
kai proselthon auto pharisaioi peirazontes auton kai legontes ei exestin anthropo apolusai ten gunaika autou kata pasan aitian
ho de apokritheis eipen ouk anegnote hoti ho ktisas ap arches arsen kai thelu epoiesen autous
kai eipen heneka toutou kataleipsei anthropos ton patera kai ten metera kai kollethesetai te gunaiki autou kai esontai hoi duo eis sarka mian
hoste ouketi eisin duo alla sarx mia ho oun ho theos sunezeuxen anthropos me chorizeto
legousin auto ti oun mouses eneteilato dounai biblion apostasiou kai apolusai auten
legei autois hoti mouses pros ten sklerokardian humon epetrepsen humin apolusai tas gunaikas humon ap arches de ou gegonen houtos
lego de humin hoti hos an apoluse ten gunaika autou me epi porneia kai gamese allen moichatai
legousin auto hoi mathetai autou ei houtos estin he aitia tou anthropou meta tes gunaikos ou sumpherei gamesai
ho de eipen autois ou pantes chorousin ton logon touton all hois dedotai

eisin gar eunouchoi hoitines ek koilias metros egennethesan houtos kai eisin eunouchoi hoitines eunouchisthesan hupo ton anthropon kai eisin eunouchoi hoitines eunouchisan heautous dia ten basileian ton ouranon ho dunamenos chorein choreito
tote prosenechthesan auto paidia hina tas cheiras epithe autois kai proseuxetai hoi de mathetai epetimesan autois
ho de iesous eipen aphete ta paidia kai me koluete auta elthein pros me ton gar toiouton estin he basileia ton ouranon
kai epitheis tas cheiras autois eporeuthe ekeithen
kai idou heis proselthon auto eipen didaskale ti agathon poieso hina scho zoen aionion
ho de eipen auto ti me erotas peri tou agathou heis estin ho agathos ei de theleis eis ten zoen eiselthein tereson tas entolas
legei auto poias ho de iesous eipen to ou phoneuseis ou moicheuseis ou klepseis ou pseudomartureseis
tima ton patera kai ten metera kai agapeseis ton plesion sou hos seauton
legei auto ho neaniskos panta tauta ephulaxa ti eti hustero
ephe auto ho iesous ei theleis teleios einai hupage poleson sou ta huparchonta kai dos tois ptochois kai hexeis thesauron en ouranois kai deuro akolouthei moi

ho de iesous eipen tois mathetais autou amen lego humin hoti plousios duskolos eiseleusetai eis ten basileian ton ouranon
palin de lego humin eukopoteron estin kamelon dia trupematos hraphidos dielthein e plousion eiselthein eis ten basileian tou theou

tote apokritheis ho petros eipen auto idou hemeis aphekamen panta kai ekolouthesamen soi ti ara estai hemin

kai pas hostis apheken oikias e adelphous e adelphas e patera e metera e tekna e agrous heneken tou onomatos mou hekatontaplasiona lempsetai kai zoen aionion kleronomesei

kai ekeinois eipen hupagete kai humeis eis ton ampelona kai ho ean e dikaion doso humin
hoi de apelthon palin de exelthon peri hekten kai enaten horan epoiesen hosautos
peri de ten hendekaten exelthon heuren allous hestotas kai legei autois ti hode hestekate holen ten hemeran argoi

houtos esontai hoi eschatoi protoi kai hoi protoi eschatoi
kai anabainon ho iesous eis hierosoluma parelaben tous dodeka mathetas kat idian kai en te hodo eipen autois

ho de iesous proskalesamenos autous eipen oidate hoti hoi archontes ton ethnon katakurieuousin auton kai hoi megaloi katexousiazousin auton
ouch houtos estai en humin all hos ean thele en humin megas genesthai estai humon diakonos
kai hos an thele en humin einai protos estai humon doulos

ho de ochlos epetimesen autois hina siopesosin hoi de meizon ekraxan legontes eleeson hemas kurie huios dauid
kai stas ho iesous ephonesen autous kai eipen ti thelete poieso humin

poreuthentes de hoi mathetai kai poiesantes kathos sunetaxen autois ho iesous

idontes de hoi archiereis kai hoi grammateis ta thaumasia ha epoiesen kai tous paidas tous krazontas en to hiero kai legontas hosanna to huio dauid eganaktesan

kai idon suken mian epi tes hodou elthen ep auten kai ouden heuren en aute ei me phulla monon kai legei aute meketi ek sou karpos genetai eis ton aiona kai exeranthe parachrema he suke
kai idontes hoi mathetai ethaumasan legontes pos parachrema exeranthe he suke

kai elthontos autou eis to hieron proselthon auto didaskonti hoi archiereis kai hoi presbuteroi tou laou legontes en poia exousia tauta poieis kai tis soi edoken ten exousian tauten

kai pollakis kai eis pur auton ebalen kai eis hudata hina apolese auton all ei ti dune boetheson hemin splanchnistheis eph hemas
ho de iesous eipen auto to ei dune panta dunata to pisteuonti
euthus kraxas ho pater tou paidiou elegen pisteuo boethei mou te apistia
idon de ho iesous hoti episuntrechei ochlos epetimesen to pneumati to akatharto legon auto to alalon kai kophon pneuma ego epitasso soi exelthe ex autou kai meketi eiselthes eis auton
kai kraxas kai polla sparaxas exelthen kai egeneto hosei nekros hoste tous pollous legein hoti apethanen
ho de iesous kratesas tes cheiros autou egeiren auton kai aneste
kai eiselthontos autou eis oikon hoi mathetai autou kat idian eperoton auton hoti hemeis ouk edunethemen ekbalein auto
kai eipen autois touto to genos en oudeni dunatai exelthein ei me en proseuche
kakeithen exelthontes pareporeuonto dia tes galilaias kai ouk ethelen hina tis gnoi
edidasken gar tous mathetas autou kai elegen autois hoti ho huios tou anthropou paradidotai eis cheiras anthropon kai apoktenousin auton kai apoktantheis meta treis hemeras anastesetai
hoi de egnooun to hrema kai ephobounto auton eperotesai
kai elthon eis kapharnaoum kai en te oikia genomenos eperota autous ti en te hodo dielogizesthe
hoi de esiopon pros allelous gar dielechthesan en te hodo tis meizon
kai kathisas ephonesen tous dodeka kai legei autois ei tis thelei protos einai estai panton eschatos kai panton diakonos
kai labon paidion estesen auto en meso auton kai enankalisamenos auto eipen autois
hos an hen ton toiouton paidion dexetai epi to onomati mou eme dechetai kai hos an eme dechetai ouk eme dechetai alla ton aposteilanta me
ephe auto ho ioannes didaskale eidomen tina en to onomati sou ekballonta daimonia kai ekoluomen auton hoti ouk ekolouthei hemin
ho de iesous eipen me koluete auton oudeis gar estin hos poiesei dunamin epi to onomati mou kai dunesetai tachu kakologesai me
hos gar ouk estin kath hemon huper hemon estin
hos gar an potise humas poterion hudatos en onomati hoti christou este amen lego humin hoti ou me apolese ton misthon autou
kai hos an skandalise hena ton mikron touton ton pisteuonton eis eme kalon estin auto mallon ei perikeitai mulos onikos peri ton trachelon autou kai bebletai eis ten thalassan
kai ean skandalize se he cheir sou apokopson auten kalon estin se kullon eiselthein eis ten zoen e tas duo cheiras echonta apelthein eis ten geennan eis to pur to asbeston
kai ean ho pous sou skandalize se apokopson auton kalon estin se eiselthein eis ten zoen cholon e tous duo podas echonta blethenai eis ten geennan
kai ean ho ophthalmos sou skandalize se ekbale auton kalon se estin monophthalmon eiselthein eis ten basileian tou theou e duo ophthalmous echonta blethenai eis ten geennan
hopou ho skolex auton ou teleuta kai to pur ou sbennutai
pas gar puri halisthesetai
kalon to halas ean de to halas analon genetai en tini auto artusete echete en heautois hala kai eireneuete en allelois
kai ekeithen anastas erchetai eis ta horia tes ioudaias kai peran tou iordanou kai sumporeuontai palin ochloi pros auton kai hos eiothei palin edidasken autous
kai proselthontes pharisaioi eperoton auton ei exestin andri gunaika apolusai peirazontes auton
ho de apokritheis eipen autois ti humin eneteilato mouses
hoi de eipan epetrepsen mouses biblion apostasiou grapsai kai apolusai
ho de iesous eipen autois pros ten sklerokardian humon egrapsen humin ten entolen tauten
apo de arches ktiseos arsen kai thelu epoiesen autous
heneken toutou kataleipsei anthropos ton patera autou kai ten metera kai proskollethesetai pros ten gunaika autou
kai esontai hoi duo eis sarka mian hoste ouketi eisin duo alla mia sarx
ho oun ho theos sunezeuxen anthropos me chorizeto
kai eis ten oikian palin hoi mathetai peri toutou eperoton auton
kai legei autois hos an apoluse ten gunaika autou kai gamese allen moichatai ep auten
kai ean aute apolusasa ton andra autes gamese allon moichatai
kai prosepheron auto paidia hina auton hapsetai hoi de mathetai epetimesan autois
idon de ho iesous eganaktesen kai eipen autois aphete ta paidia erchesthai pros me me koluete auta ton gar toiouton estin he basileia tou theou
amen lego humin hos an me dexetai ten basileian tou theou hos paidion ou me eiselthe eis auten
kai enankalisamenos auta kateulogei titheis tas cheiras ep auta
kai ekporeuomenou autou eis hodon prosdramon heis kai gonupetesas auton eperota auton didaskale agathe ti poieso hina zoen aionion kleronomeso
ho de iesous eipen auto ti me legeis agathon oudeis agathos ei me heis ho theos
tas entolas oidas me phoneuses me moicheuses me klepses me pseudomartureses me apostereses tima ton patera sou kai ten metera
ho de ephe auto didaskale tauta panta ephulaxamen ek neotetos mou
ho de iesous emblepsas auto egapesen auton kai eipen auto hen se husterei hupage hosa echeis poleson kai dos tois ptochois kai hexeis thesauron en ourano kai deuro akolouthei moi
ho de stugnasas epi to logo apelthen lupoumenos en gar echon ktemata polla
kai periblepsamenos ho iesous legei tois mathetais autou pos duskolos hoi ta chremata echontes eis ten basileian tou theou eiseleusontai
hoi de mathetai ethambounto epi tois logois autou ho de iesous palin apokritheis legei autois tekna pos duskolon estin eis ten basileian tou theou eiselthein
eukopoteron estin kamelon dia tes trumalias tes hraphidos dielthein e plousion eis ten basileian tou theou eiselthein
hoi de perissos exeplessonto legontes pros heautous kai tis dunatai sothenai
emblepsas autois ho iesous legei para anthropois adunaton all ou para theo panta gar dunata para to theo
erxato legein ho petros auto idou hemeis aphekamen panta kai ekolouthekamen soi
ephe ho iesous amen lego humin oudeis estin hos apheken oikian e adelphous e adelphas e metera e patera e tekna e agrous heneken emou kai heneken tou euaneliou
ean me labe hekatontaplasiona nun en to kairo touto oikias kai adelphous kai adelphas kai meteras kai tekna kai agrous meta diogmon kai en to aioni to erchomeno zoen aionion

esan de en te hodo anabainontes eis hierosoluma kai en proagon autous ho iesous kai ethambounto hoi de akolouthountes ephobounto kai paralabon palin tous dodeka erxato autois legein ta mellonta auto sumbainein
hoti idou anabainomen eis hierosoluma kai ho huios tou anthropou paradothesetai tois archiereusin kai tois grammateusin kai katakrinousin auton thanato kai paradosousin auton tois ethnesin

ho de eipen autois ti thelete me poieso humin
hoi de eipan auto dos hemin hina heis sou ek dexion kai heis ex aristeron kathisomen en te doxe sou

hoi de eipan auto dunametha ho de iesous eipen autois to poterion ho ego pino piesthe kai to baptisma ho ego baptizomai baptisthesesthe
to de kathisai ek dexion mou e ex euonumon ouk estin emon dounai all hois hetoimastai
kai akousantes hoi deka erxanto aganaktein peri iakobou kai ioannou
kai proskalesamenos autous ho iesous legei autois oidate hoti hoi dokountes archein ton ethnon katakurieuousin auton kai hoi megaloi auton katexousiazousin auton
ouch houtos de estin en humin all hos an thele megas genesthai en humin estai humon diakonos
kai hos an thele en humin einai protos estai panton doulos
kai gar ho huios tou anthropou ouk elthen diakonethenai alla diakonesai kai dounai ten psuchen autou lutron anti pollon
kai erchontai eis iericho kai ekporeuomenou autou apo iericho kai ton matheton autou kai ochlou hikanou ho huios timaiou bartimaios tuphlos prosaites ekatheto para ten hodon
kai akousas hoti iesous ho nazarenos estin erxato krazein kai legein huie dauid iesou eleeson me
kai epetimon auto polloi hina siopese ho de pollo mallon ekrazen huie dauid eleeson me
kai stas ho iesous eipen phonesate auton kai phonousin ton tuphlon legontes auto tharsei egeire phonei se
ho de apobalon to himation autou anapedesas elthen pros ton iesoun
kai apokritheis auto ho iesous eipen ti soi theleis poieso ho de tuphlos eipen auto rabbouni hina anablepso
kai ho iesous eipen auto hupage he pistis sou sesoken se kai euthus aneblepsen kai ekolouthei auto en te hodo
kai hote enizousin eis hierosoluma eis bethphage kai bethanian pros to oros ton elaion apostellei duo ton matheton autou
kai legei autois hupagete eis ten komen ten katenanti humon kai euthus eisporeuomenoi eis auten heuresete polon dedemenon eph hon oudeis oupo anthropon ekathisen lusate auton kai pherete
kai ean tis humin eipe ti poieite touto eipate ho kurios autou chreian echei kai euthus auton apostellei palin hode
kai apelthon kai heuron polon dedemenon pros thuran exo epi tou amphodou kai luousin auton
kai tines ton ekei hestekoton elegon autois ti poieite luontes ton polon
hoi de eipan autois kathos eipen ho iesous kai aphekan autous
kai pherousin ton polon pros ton iesoun kai epiballousin auto ta himatia auton kai ekathisen ep auton
kai polloi ta himatia auton estrosan eis ten hodon alloi de stibadas kopsantes ek ton agron

kai eiselthen eis hierosoluma eis to hieron kai periblepsamenos panta opsias ede ouses tes horas exelthen eis bethanian meta ton dodeka

kai apokritheis eipen aute meketi eis ton aiona ek sou medeis karpon phagoi kai ekouon hoi mathetai autou

kai ouk ephien hina tis dienenke skeuos dia tou hierou
kai edidasken kai elegen autois ou gegraptai hoti ho oikos mou oikos proseuches klethesetai pasin tois ethnesin humeis de pepoiekate auton spelaion leston
kai ekousan hoi archiereis kai hoi grammateis kai ezetoun pos auton apolesosin ephobounto gar auton pas gar ho ochlos exeplesseto epi te didache autou
kai hotan opse egeneto exeporeuonto exo tes poleos
kai paraporeuomenoi proi eidon ten suken exerammenen ek hrizon

kai apokritheis ho iesous legei autois echete pistin theou
amen lego humin hoti hos an eipe to orei touto artheti kai bletheti eis ten thalassan kai me diakrithe en te kardia autou alla pisteue hoti ho lalei ginetai estai auto
dia touto lego humin panta hosa proseuchesthe kai aiteisthe pisteuete hoti elabete kai estai humin

kai erchontai palin eis hierosoluma kai en to hiero peripatountos autou erchontai pros auton hoi archiereis kai hoi grammateis kai hoi presbuteroi

to baptisma to ioannou ex ouranou en e ex anthropon apokrithete moi
kai dielogizonto pros heautous legontes ean eipomen ex ouranou erei dia ti oun ouk episteusate auto
alla eipomen ex anthropon ephobounto ton ochlon hapantes gar eichon ton ioannen ontos hoti prophetes en
kai apokrithentes to iesou legousin ouk oidamen kai ho iesous legei autois oude ego lego humin en poia exousia tauta poio
kai erxato autois en parabolais lalein ampelona anthropos ephuteusen kai perietheken phragmon kai oruxen hupolenion kai okodomesen purgon kai exedeto auton georgois kai apedemesen
kai apesteilen pros tous georgous to kairo doulon hina para ton georgon labe apo ton karpon tou ampelonos
kai labontes auton edeiran kai apesteilan kenon
kai palin apesteilen pros autous allon doulon kakeinon ekephaliosan kai etimasan
kai allon apesteilen kakeinon apekteinan kai pollous allous hous men derontes hous de apoktennontes
eti hena eichen huion agapeton apesteilen auton eschaton pros autous legon hoti entrapesontai ton huion mou
ekeinoi de hoi georgoi pros heautous eipan hoti houtos estin ho kleronomos deute apokteinomen auton kai hemon estai he kleronomia
kai labontes apekteinan auton kai exebalon auton exo tou ampelonos
ti oun poiesei ho kurios tou ampelonos eleusetai kai apolesei tous georgous kai dosei ton ampelona allois
oude ten graphen tauten anegnote lithon hon apedokimasan hoi oikodomountes houtos egenethe eis kephalen gonias
para kuriou egeneto haute kai estin thaumaste en ophthalmois hemon
kai ezetoun auton kratesai kai ephobethesan ton ochlon egnosan gar hoti pros autous ten parabolen eipen kai aphentes auton apelthon
kai apostellousin pros auton tinas ton pharisaion kai ton herodianon hina auton agreusosin logo

kai elthontes legousin auto didaskale oidamen hoti alethes ei kai ou melei soi peri oudenos ou gar blepeis eis prosopon anthropon all ep aletheias ten hodon tou theou didaskeis exestin dounai kenson kaisari e ou domen e me domen
ho de eidos auton ten hupokrisin eipen autois ti me peirazete pherete moi denarion hina ido
hoi de enenkan kai legei autois tinos he eikon haute kai he epigraphe hoi de eipan auto kaisaros
ho de iesous eipen autois ta kaisaros apodote kaisari kai ta tou theou to theo kai exethaumazon ep auto
kai erchontai saddoukaioi pros auton hoitines legousin anastasin me einai kai eperoton auton legontes
didaskale mouses egrapsen hemin hoti ean tinos adelphos apothane kai katalipe gunaika kai me aphe teknon hina labe ho adelphos autou ten gunaika kai exanastese sperma to adelpho autou
hepta adelphoi esan kai ho protos elaben gunaika kai apothneskon ouk apheken sperma
kai ho deuteros elaben auten kai apethanen me katalipon sperma kai ho tritos hosautos
kai hoi hepta ouk aphekan sperma eschaton panton kai he gune apethanen
en te anastasei hotan anastosin tinos auton estai gune hoi gar hepta eschon auten gunaika
ephe autois ho iesous ou dia touto planasthe me eidotes tas graphas mede ten dunamin tou theou
hotan gar ek nekron anastosin oute gamousin oute gamizontai all eisin hos aneloi en tois ouranois
peri de ton nekron hoti egeirontai ouk anegnote en te biblo mouseos epi tou batou pos eipen auto ho theos legon ego ho theos abraam kai ho theos isaak kai ho theos iakob
ouk estin theos nekron alla zonton polu planasthe
kai proselthon heis ton grammateon akousas auton suzetounton idon hoti kalos apekrithe autois eperotesen auton poia estin entole prote panton
apekrithe ho iesous hoti prote estin akoue israel kurios ho theos hemon kurios heis estin
kai agapeseis kurion ton theon sou ex holes tes kardias sou kai ex holes tes psuches sou kai ex holes tes dianoias sou kai ex holes tes ischuos sou
deutera haute agapeseis ton plesion sou hos seauton meizon touton alle entole ouk estin
kai eipen auto ho grammateus kalos didaskale ep aletheias eipes hoti heis estin kai ouk estin allos plen autou
kai to agapan auton ex holes tes kardias kai ex holes tes suneseos kai ex holes tes ischuos kai to agapan ton plesion hos heauton perissoteron estin panton ton holokautomaton kai thusion

kai apokritheis ho iesous elegen didaskon en to hiero pos legousin hoi grammateis hoti ho christos huios dauid estin
autos dauid eipen en to pneumati to hagio eipen kurios to kurio mou kathou ek dexion mou heos an tho tous echthrous sou hupokato ton podon sou
autos dauid legei auton kurion kai pothen autou estin huios kai ho polus ochlos ekouen autou hedeos
kai en te didache autou elegen blepete apo ton grammateon ton thelonton en stolais peripatein kai aspasmous en tais agorais
kai protokathedrias en tais sunagogais kai protoklisias en tois deipnois
hoi katesthiontes tas oikias ton cheron kai prophasei makra proseuchomenoi houtoi lempsontai perissoteron krima
kai kathisas katenanti tou gazophulakiou etheorei pos ho ochlos ballei chalkon eis to gazophulakion kai polloi plousioi eballon polla

kai proskalesamenos tous mathetas autou eipen autois amen lego humin hoti he chera haute he ptoche pleion panton ebalen ton ballonton eis to gazophulakion
pantes gar ek tou perisseuontos autois ebalon haute de ek tes hustereseos autes panta hosa eichen ebalen holon ton bion autes
kai ekporeuomenou autou ek tou hierou legei auto heis ton matheton autou didaskale ide potapoi lithoi kai potapai oikodomai
kai ho iesous eipen auto blepeis tautas tas megalas oikodomas ou me aphethe hode lithos epi lithon hos ou me kataluthe
kai kathemenou autou eis to oros ton elaion katenanti tou hierou eperota auton kat idian petros kai iakobos kai ioannes kai andreas
eipon hemin pote tauta estai kai ti to semeion hotan melle tauta sunteleisthai panta
ho de iesous erxato legein autois blepete me tis humas planese
polloi eleusontai epi to onomati mou legontes hoti ego eimi kai pollous planesousin
hotan de akousete polemous kai akoas polemon me throeisthe dei genesthai all oupo to telos
egerthesetai gar ethnos ep ethnos kai basileia epi basileian esontai seismoi kata topous esontai limoi arche odinon tauta
blepete de humeis heautous paradosousin humas eis sunedria kai eis sunagogas daresesthe kai epi hegemonon kai basileon stathesesthe heneken emou eis marturion autois
kai eis panta ta ethne proton dei keruchthenai to euanelion
kai hotan agosin humas paradidontes me promerimnate ti lalesete all ho ean dothe humin en ekeine te hora touto laleite ou gar este humeis hoi lalountes alla to pneuma to hagion
kai paradosei adelphos adelphon eis thanaton kai pater teknon kai epanastesontai tekna epi goneis kai thanatosousin autous
kai esesthe misoumenoi hupo panton dia to onoma mou ho de hupomeinas eis telos houtos sothesetai
hotan de idete to bdelugma tes eremoseos hestekota hopou ou dei ho anaginoskon noeito tote hoi en te ioudaia pheugetosan eis ta ore
ho de epi tou domatos me katabato mede eiselthato arai ti ek tes oikias autou
kai ho eis ton agron me epistrepsato eis ta opiso arai to himation autou
ouai de tais en gastri echousais kai tais thelazousais en ekeinais tais hemerais
proseuchesthe de hina me genetai cheimonos
esontai gar hai hemerai ekeinai thlipsis hoia ou gegonen toiaute ap arches ktiseos hen ektisen ho theos heos tou nun kai ou me genetai
kai ei me ekolobosen kurios tas hemeras ouk an esothe pasa sarx alla dia tous eklektous hous exelexato ekolobosen tas hemeras
kai tote ean tis humin eipe ide hode ho christos ide ekei me pisteuete
egerthesontai gar pseudochristoi kai pseudoprophetai kai dosousin semeia kai terata pros to apoplanan ei dunaton tous eklektous
humeis de blepete proeireka humin panta
alla en ekeinais tais hemerais meta ten thlipsin ekeinen ho helios skotisthesetai kai he selene ou dosei to phenos autes
kai hoi asteres esontai ek tou ouranou piptontes kai hai dunameis hai en tois ouranois saleuthesontai
kai tote opsontai ton huion tou anthropou erchomenon en nephelais meta dunameos polles kai doxes
kai tote apostelei tous anelous kai episunaxei tous eklektous autou ek ton tessaron anemon ap akrou ges heos akrou ouranou
apo de tes sukes mathete ten parabolen hotan ede ho klados autes hapalos genetai kai ekphue ta phulla ginoskete hoti enus to theros estin
houtos kai humeis hotan idete tauta ginomena ginoskete hoti enus estin epi thurais
amen lego humin hoti ou me parelthe he genea haute mechris hou tauta panta genetai
ho ouranos kai he ge pareleusontai hoi de logoi mou ou me pareleusontai
peri de tes hemeras ekeines e tes horas oudeis oiden oude hoi aneloi en ourano oude ho huios ei me ho pater
blepete agrupneite ouk oidate gar pote ho kairos estin
hos anthropos apodemos apheis ten oikian autou kai dous tois doulois autou ten exousian hekasto to ergon autou kai to thuroro eneteilato hina gregore
gregoreite oun ouk oidate gar pote ho kurios tes oikias erchetai e opse e mesonuktion e alektorophonias e proi
me elthon exaiphnes heure humas katheudontas
ho de humin lego pasin lego gregoreite
en de to pascha kai ta azuma meta duo hemeras kai ezetoun hoi archiereis kai hoi grammateis pos auton en dolo kratesantes apokteinosin
elegon gar me en te heorte mepote estai thorubos tou laou
kai ontos autou en bethania en te oikia simonos tou leprou katakeimenou autou elthen gune echousa alabastron murou nardou pistikes polutelous suntripsasa ten alabastron katecheen autou tes kephales
esan de tines aganaktountes pros heautous eis ti he apoleia haute tou murou gegonen
edunato gar touto to muron prathenai epano denarion triakosion kai dothenai tois ptochois kai enebrimonto aute

kratountos de autou ton petron kai ton ioannen sunedramen pas ho laos pros autous epi te stoa te kaloumene solomontos ekthamboi
idon de ho petros apekrinato pros ton laon andres israelitai ti thaumazete epi touto e hemin ti atenizete hos idia dunamei e eusebeia pepoiekosin tou peripatein auton

ho theos abraam kai ho theos isaak kai ho theos iakob ho theos ton pateron hemon edoxasen ton paida autou iesoun hon humeis men paredokate kai ernesasthe kata prosopon pilatou krinantos ekeinou apoluein
humeis de ton hagion kai dikaion ernesasthe kai etesasthe andra phonea charisthenai humin
ton de archegon tes zoes apekteinate hon ho theos egeiren ek nekron hou hemeis martures esmen
kai epi te pistei tou onomatos autou touton hon theoreite kai oidate estereosen to onoma autou kai he pistis he di autou edoken auto ten holoklerian tauten apenanti panton humon
kai nun adelphoi oida hoti kata agnoian epraxate hosper kai hoi archontes humon
ho de theos ha prokateneilen dia stomatos panton ton propheton pathein ton christon autou eplerosen houtos
metanoesate oun kai epistrepsate pros to exaleiphthenai humon tas hamartias
hopos an elthosin kairoi anapsuxeos apo prosopou tou kuriou kai aposteile ton prokecheirismenon humin christon iesoun
hon dei ouranon men dexasthai achri chronon apokatastaseos panton hon elalesen ho theos dia stomatos ton hagion ap aionos autou propheton
mouses men eipen hoti propheten humin anastesei kurios ho theos humon ek ton adelphon humon hos eme autou akousesthe kata panta hosa an lalese pros humas
estai de pasa psuche hetis ean me akouse tou prophetou ekeinou exolethreuthesetai ek tou laou
kai pantes de hoi prophetai apo samouel kai ton kathexes hosoi elalesan kai kateneilan tas hemeras tautas
humeis este hoi huioi ton propheton kai tes diathekes hes dietheto ho theos pros tous pateras humon legon pros abraam kai en to spermati sou eneulogethesontai pasai hai patriai tes ges
humin proton anastesas ho theos ton paida autou apesteilen auton eulogounta humas en to apostrephein hekaston apo ton ponerion humon
lalounton de auton pros ton laon epestesan autois hoi hiereis kai ho strategos tou hierou kai hoi saddoukaioi
diaponoumenoi dia to didaskein autous ton laon kai katanellein en to iesou ten anastasin ten ek nekron
kai epebalon autois tas cheiras kai ethento eis teresin eis ten aurion en gar hespera ede
polloi de ton akousanton ton logon episteusan kai egenethe ho arithmos ton andron hos chiliades pente
egeneto de epi ten aurion sunachthenai auton tous archontas kai tous presbuterous kai tous grammateis en ierousalem
kai hannas ho archiereus kai kaiaphas kai ioannes kai alexandros kai hosoi esan ek genous archieratikou
kai stesantes autous en to meso epunthanonto en poia dunamei e en poio onomati epoiesate touto humeis
tote petros plestheis pneumatos hagiou eipen pros autous archontes tou laou kai presbuteroi
ei hemeis semeron anakrinometha epi euergesia anthropou asthenous en tini houtos sesostai
gnoston esto pasin humin kai panti to lao israel hoti en to onomati iesou christou tou nazoraiou hon humeis estaurosate hon ho theos egeiren ek nekron en touto houtos paresteken enopion humon hugies
houtos estin ho lithos ho exouthenetheis huph humon ton oikodomon ho genomenos eis kephalen gonias
kai ouk estin en allo oudeni he soteria oude gar onoma estin heteron hupo ton ouranon to dedomenon en anthropois en ho dei sothenai hemas
theorountes de ten tou petrou parresian kai ioannou kai katalabomenoi hoti anthropoi agrammatoi eisin kai idiotai ethaumazon epeginoskon te autous hoti sun to iesou esan
ton te anthropon blepontes sun autois hestota ton tetherapeumenon ouden eichon anteipein
keleusantes de autous exo tou sunedriou apelthein suneballon pros allelous
legontes ti poiesomen tois anthropois toutois hoti men gar gnoston semeion gegonen di auton pasin tois katoikousin ierousalem phaneron kai ou dunametha arneisthai
all hina me epi pleion dianemethe eis ton laon apeilesometha autois meketi lalein epi to onomati touto medeni anthropon
kai kalesantes autous pareneilan to katholou me phthenesthai mede didaskein epi to onomati tou iesou
ho de petros kai ioannes apokrithentes eipon pros autous ei dikaion estin enopion tou theou humon akouein mallon e tou theou krinate
ou dunametha gar hemeis ha eidamen kai ekousamen me lalein
hoi de prosapeilesamenoi apelusan autous meden heuriskontes to pos kolasontai autous dia ton laon hoti pantes edoxazon ton theon epi to gegonoti
eton gar en pleionon tesserakonta ho anthropos eph hon gegonei to semeion touto tes iaseos
apoluthentes de elthon pros tous idious kai apeneilan hosa pros autous hoi archiereis kai hoi presbuteroi eipan
hoi de akousantes homothumadon eran phonen pros ton theon kai eipan despota su ho poiesas ton ouranon kai ten gen kai ten thalassan kai panta ta en autois
ho tou patros hemon dia pneumatos hagiou stomatos dauid paidos sou eipon hinati ephruaxan ethne kai laoi emeletesan kena
parestesan hoi basileis tes ges kai hoi archontes sunechthesan epi to auto kata tou kuriou kai kata tou christou autou
sunechthesan gar ep aletheias en te polei taute epi ton hagion paida sou iesoun hon echrisas herodes te kai pontios pilatos sun ethnesin kai laois israel
poiesai hosa he cheir sou kai he boule sou proorisen genesthai
kai ta nun kurie epide epi tas apeilas auton kai dos tois doulois sou meta parresias pases lalein ton logon sou
en to ten cheira sou ekteinein se eis iasin kai semeia kai terata ginesthai dia tou onomatos tou hagiou paidos sou iesou
kai deethenton auton esaleuthe ho topos en ho esan sunegmenoi kai eplesthesan hapantes tou hagiou pneumatos kai elaloun ton logon tou theou meta parresias
tou de plethous ton pisteusanton en kardia kai psuche mia kai oude heis ti ton huparchonton auto elegen idion einai all en autois panta koina
kai dunamei megale apedidoun to marturion hoi apostoloi tes anastaseos tou kuriou iesou charis te megale en epi pantas autous
oude gar endees tis en en autois hosoi gar ktetores chorion e oikion huperchon polountes epheron tas timas ton pipraskomenon
kai etithoun para tous podas ton apostolon diedideto de hekasto kathoti an tis chreian eichen
ioseph de ho epikletheis barnabas apo ton apostolon ho estin methermeneuomenon huios parakleseos leuites kuprios to genei
huparchontos auto agrou polesas enenken to chrema kai etheken pros tous podas ton apostolon
aner de tis hananias onomati sun sapphire te gunaiki autou epolesen ktema
kai enosphisato apo tes times suneiduies kai tes gunaikos kai enenkas meros ti para tous podas ton apostolon etheken
eipen de ho petros hanania dia ti eplerosen ho satanas ten kardian sou pseusasthai se to pneuma to hagion kai nosphisasthai apo tes times tou choriou
ouchi menon soi emenen kai prathen en te se exousia huperchen ti hoti ethou en te kardia sou to pragma touto ouk epseuso anthropois alla to theo
akouon de ho hananias tous logous toutous peson exepsuxen kai egeneto phobos megas epi pantas tous akouontas
anastantes de hoi neoteroi sunesteilan auton kai exenenkantes ethapsan
egeneto de hos horon trion diastema kai he gune autou me eiduia to gegonos eiselthen
apekrithe de pros auten petros eipe moi ei tosoutou to chorion apedosthe he de eipen nai tosoutou
ho de petros pros auten ti hoti sunephonethe humin peirasai to pneuma kuriou idou hoi podes ton thapsanton ton andra sou epi te thura kai exoisousin se
epesen de parachrema pros tous podas autou kai exepsuxen eiselthontes de hoi neaniskoi heuron auten nekran kai exenenkantes ethapsan pros ton andra autes
kai egeneto phobos megas eph holen ten ekklesian kai epi pantas tous akouontas tauta
dia de ton cheiron ton apostolon egineto semeia kai terata polla en to lao kai esan homothumadon hapantes en te stoa solomontos
ton de loipon oudeis etolma kollasthai autois all emegalunen autous ho laos
mallon de prosetithento pisteuontes to kurio plethe andron te kai gunaikon
hoste kai eis tas plateias ekpherein tous astheneis kai tithenai epi klinarion kai krabatton hina erchomenou petrou kan he skia episkiase tini auton
sunercheto de kai to plethos ton perix poleon ierousalem pherontes astheneis kai ochloumenous hupo pneumaton akatharton hoitines etherapeuonto hapantes
anastas de ho archiereus kai pantes hoi sun auto he ousa hairesis ton saddoukaion eplesthesan zelou
kai epebalon tas cheiras epi tous apostolous kai ethento autous en teresei demosia
anelos de kuriou dia nuktos enoixe tas thuras tes phulakes exagagon te autous eipen
poreuesthe kai stathentes laleite en to hiero to lao panta ta hremata tes zoes tautes

akousantes de eiselthon hupo ton orthron eis to hieron kai edidaskon paragenomenos de ho archiereus kai hoi sun auto sunekalesan to sunedrion kai pasan ten gerousian ton huion israel kai apesteilan eis to desmoterion achthenai autous
hoi de paragenomenoi huperetai ouch heuron autous en te phulake anastrepsantes de apeneilan
legontes hoti to desmoterion heuromen kekleismenon en pase asphaleia kai tous phulakas hestotas epi ton thuron anoixantes de eso oudena heuromen
hos de ekousan tous logous toutous ho te strategos tou hierou kai hoi archiereis dieporoun peri auton ti an genoito touto
paragenomenos de tis apeneilen autois hoti idou hoi andres hous ethesthe en te phulake eisin en to hiero hestotes kai didaskontes ton laon
tote apelthon ho strategos sun tois huperetais egen autous ou meta bias ephobounto gar ton laon me lithasthosin
agagontes de autous estesan en to sunedrio kai eperotesen autous ho archiereus
legon ou paranelia pareneilamen humin me didaskein epi to onomati touto kai idou peplerokate ten ierousalem tes didaches humon kai boulesthe epagagein eph hemas to haima tou anthropou toutou
apokritheis de petros kai hoi apostoloi eipan peitharchein dei theo mallon e anthropois
ho theos ton pateron hemon egeiren iesoun hon humeis diecheirisasthe kremasantes epi xulou
touton ho theos archegon kai sotera hupsosen te dexia autou tou dounai metanoian to israel kai aphesin hamartion
kai hemeis esmen martures ton hrematon touton kai to pneuma to hagion ho edoken ho theos tois peitharchousin auto
hoi de akousantes dieprionto kai eboulonto anelein autous
anastas de tis en to sunedrio pharisaios onomati gamaliel nomodidaskalos timios panti to lao ekeleusen exo brachu tous anthropous poiesai
eipen te pros autous andres israelitai prosechete heautois epi tois anthropois toutois ti mellete prassein
pro gar touton ton hemeron aneste theudas legon einai tina heauton ho proseklithe andron arithmos hos tetrakosion hos anerethe kai pantes hosoi epeithonto auto dieluthesan kai egenonto eis ouden
meta touton aneste ioudas ho galilaios en tais hemerais tes apographes kai apestesen laon opiso autou kakeinos apoleto kai pantes hosoi epeithonto auto dieskorpisthesan
kai ta nun lego humin apostete apo ton anthropon touton kai aphete autous hoti ean e ex anthropon he boule haute e to ergon touto kataluthesetai
ei de ek theou estin ou dunesesthe katalusai autous mepote kai theomachoi heurethete epeisthesan de auto
kai proskalesamenoi tous apostolous deirantes pareneilan me lalein epi to onomati tou iesou kai apelusan
hoi men oun eporeuonto chairontes apo prosopou tou sunedriou hoti katexiothesan huper tou onomatos atimasthenai
pasan te hemeran en to hiero kai kat oikon ouk epauonto didaskontes kai euanelizomenoi ton christon iesoun
en de tais hemerais tautais plethunonton ton matheton egeneto gonusmos ton helleniston pros tous hebraious hoti paretheorounto en te diakonia te kathemerine hai cherai auton
proskalesamenoi de hoi dodeka to plethos ton matheton eipan ouk areston estin hemas kataleipsantas ton logon tou theou diakonein trapezais
episkepsasthe de adelphoi andras ex humon marturoumenous hepta plereis pneumatos kai sophias hous katastesomen epi tes chreias tautes
hemeis de te proseuche kai te diakonia tou logou proskarteresomen

kai eresen ho logos enopion pantos tou plethous kai exelexanto stephanon andra pleres pisteos kai pneumatos hagiou kai philippon kai prochoron kai nikanora kai timona kai parmenan kai nikolaon proseluton antiochea
hous estesan enopion ton apostolon kai proseuxamenoi epethekan autois tas cheiras
kai ho logos tou theou euxanen kai eplethuneto ho arithmos ton matheton en ierousalem sphodra polus te ochlos ton hiereon hupekouon te pistei
stephanos de pleres charitos kai dunameos epoiei terata kai semeia megala en to lao
anestesan de tines ton ek tes sunagoges tes legomenes libertinon kai kurenaion kai alexandreon kai ton apo kilikias kai asias suzetountes to stephano
kai ouk ischuon antistenai te sophia kai to pneumati ho elalei
tote hupebalon andras legontas hoti akekoamen autou lalountos hremata blasphema eis mousen kai ton theon
sunekinesan te ton laon kai tous presbuterous kai tous grammateis kai epistantes sunerpasan auton kai egagon eis to sunedrion
estesan te marturas pseudeis legontas ho anthropos houtos ou pauetai lalon hremata kata tou topou tou hagiou toutou kai tou nomou
akekoamen gar autou legontos hoti iesous ho nazoraios houtos katalusei ton topon touton kai allaxei ta ethe ha paredoken hemin mouses
kai atenisantes eis auton pantes hoi kathezomenoi en to sunedrio eidon to prosopon autou hosei prosopon anelou
eipen de ho archiereus ei tauta houtos echei
ho de ephe andres adelphoi kai pateres akousate ho theos tes doxes ophthe to patri hemon abraam onti en te mesopotamia prin e katoikesai auton en charran
kai eipen pros auton exelthe ek tes ges sou kai ek tes suneneias sou kai deuro eis ten gen hen an soi deixo
tote exelthon ek ges chaldaion katokesen en charran kakeithen meta to apothanein ton patera autou metokisen auton eis ten gen tauten eis hen humeis nun katoikeite
kai ouk edoken auto kleronomian en aute oude bema podos kai epeneilato dounai auto eis kataschesin auten kai to spermati autou met auton ouk ontos auto teknou
elalesen de houtos ho theos hoti estai to sperma autou paroikon en ge allotria kai doulosousin auto kai kakosousin ete tetrakosia
kai to ethnos ho ean douleusousin krino ego ho theos eipen kai meta tauta exeleusontai kai latreusousin moi en to topo touto
kai edoken auto diatheken peritomes kai houtos egennesen ton isaak kai perietemen auton te hemera te ogdoe kai isaak ton iakob kai iakob tous dodeka patriarchas
kai hoi patriarchai zelosantes ton ioseph apedonto eis aigupton kai en ho theos met autou
kai exeilato auton ek pason ton thlipseon autou kai edoken auto charin kai sophian enantion pharao basileos aiguptou kai katestesen auton hegoumenon ep aigupton kai eph holon ton oikon autou
elthen de limos eph holen ten aigupton kai chanaan kai thlipsis megale kai ouch heuriskon chortasmata hoi pateres hemon
akousas de iakob onta sitia eis aigupton exapesteilen tous pateras hemon proton
kai en to deutero anegnoristhe ioseph tois adelphois autou kai phaneron egeneto to pharao to genos tou ioseph
aposteilas de ioseph metekalesato iakob ton patera autou kai pasan ten suneneian en psuchais hebdomekonta pente
kai katebe iakob eis aigupton kai eteleutesen autos kai hoi pateres hemon
kai metetethesan eis suchem kai etethesan en to mnemati ho onesato abraam times arguriou para ton huion hemmor en suchem
kathos de enizen ho chronos tes epanelias hes homologesen ho theos to abraam euxesen ho laos kai eplethunthe en aigupto
achri hou aneste basileus heteros ep aigupton hos ouk edei ton ioseph
houtos katasophisamenos to genos hemon ekakosen tous pateras hemon tou poiein ta brephe ektheta auton eis to me zoogoneisthai
en ho kairo egennethe mouses kai en asteios to theo hos anetraphe menas treis en to oiko tou patros
ektethentos de autou aneilato auton he thugater pharao kai anethrepsato auton heaute eis huion
kai epaideuthe mouses en pase sophia aiguption en de dunatos en logois kai ergois autou
hos de eplerouto auto tesserakontaetes chronos anebe epi ten kardian autou episkepsasthai tous adelphous autou tous huious israel
kai idon tina adikoumenon emunato kai epoiesen ekdikesin to kataponoumeno pataxas ton aiguption
enomizen de sunienai tous adelphous autou hoti ho theos dia cheiros autou didosin soterian autois hoi de ou sunekan
te te epiouse hemera ophthe autois machomenois kai sunellassen autous eis eirenen eipon andres adelphoi este hinati adikeite allelous
ho de adikon ton plesion aposato auton eipon tis se katestesen archonta kai dikasten eph hemon
me anelein me su theleis hon tropon aneiles echthes ton aiguption
ephugen de mouses en to logo touto kai egeneto paroikos en ge madiam hou egennesen huious duo
kai plerothenton eton tesserakonta ophthe auto en te eremo tou orous sina anelos en phlogi puros batou
ho de mouses idon ethaumazen to horama proserchomenou de autou katanoesai egeneto phone kuriou
ego ho theos ton pateron sou ho theos abraam kai isaak kai iakob entromos de genomenos mouses ouk etolma katanoesai
eipen de auto ho kurios luson to hupodema ton podon sou ho gar topos eph ho hestekas ge hagia estin
idon eidon ten kakosin tou laou mou tou en aigupto kai tou stenagmou auton ekousa kai kateben exelesthai autous kai nun deuro aposteilo se eis aigupton
touton ton mousen hon ernesanto eipontes tis se katestesen archonta kai dikasten touton ho theos kai archonta kai lutroten apestalken sun cheiri anelou tou ophthentos auto en te bato
houtos exegagen autous poiesas terata kai semeia en ge aigupto kai en eruthra thalasse kai en te eremo ete tesserakonta
houtos estin ho mouses ho eipas tois huiois israel propheten humin anastesei ho theos ek ton adelphon humon hos eme
houtos estin ho genomenos en te ekklesia en te eremo meta tou anelou tou lalountos auto en to orei sina kai ton pateron hemon hos edexato logia zonta dounai hemin
ho ouk ethelesan hupekooi genesthai hoi pateres hemon alla aposanto kai estraphesan en tais kardiais auton eis aigupton
eipontes to aaron poieson hemin theous hoi proporeusontai hemon ho gar mouses houtos hos exegagen hemas ek ges aiguptou ouk oidamen ti egeneto auto
kai emoschopoiesan en tais hemerais ekeinais kai anegagon thusian to eidolo kai euphrainonto en tois ergois ton cheiron auton
estrepsen de ho theos kai paredoken autous latreuein te stratia tou ouranou kathos gegraptai en biblo ton propheton me sphagia kai thusias prosenenkate moi ete tesserakonta en te eremo oikos israel
kai anelabete ten skenen tou moloch kai to astron tou theou humon hraiphan tous tupous hous epoiesate proskunein autois kai metoikio humas epekeina babulonos
he skene tou marturiou en tois patrasin hemon en te eremo kathos dietaxato ho lalon to mouse poiesai auten kata ton tupon hon heorakei
hen kai eisegagon diadexamenoi hoi pateres hemon meta iesou en te kataschesei ton ethnon hon exosen ho theos apo prosopou ton pateron hemon heos ton hemeron dauid
hos heuren charin enopion tou theou kai etesato heurein skenoma to oiko iakob
solomon de oikodomesen auto oikon
all ouch ho hupsistos en cheiropoietois katoikei kathos ho prophetes legei
ho ouranos moi thronos he de ge hupopodion ton podon mou poion oikon oikodomesete moi legei kurios e tis topos tes katapauseos mou
ouchi he cheir mou epoiesen tauta panta
sklerotracheloi kai aperitmetoi kardiais kai tois osin humeis aei to pneumati to hagio antipiptete hos hoi pateres humon kai humeis
tina ton propheton ouk edioxan hoi pateres humon kai apekteinan tous prokataneilantas peri tes eleuseos tou dikaiou hou nun humeis prodotai kai phoneis egenesthe
hoitines elabete ton nomon eis diatagas anelon kai ouk ephulaxate
akouontes de tauta dieprionto tais kardiais auton kai ebruchon tous odontas ep auton
huparchon de pleres pneumatos hagiou atenisas eis ton ouranon eiden doxan theou kai iesoun hestota ek dexion tou theou
kai eipen idou theoro tous ouranous dienoigmenous kai ton huion tou anthropou ek dexion hestota tou theou
kraxantes de phone megale suneschon ta ota auton kai hormesan homothumadon ep auton
kai ekbalontes exo tes poleos elithoboloun kai hoi martures apethento ta himatia auton para tous podas neaniou kaloumenou saulou
kai elithoboloun ton stephanon epikaloumenon kai legonta kurie iesou dexai to pneuma mou
theis de ta gonata ekraxen phone megale kurie me steses autois tauten ten hamartian kai touto eipon ekoimethe

saulos de en suneudokon te anairesei autou egeneto de en ekeine te hemera diogmos megas epi ten ekklesian ten en hierosolumois pantes de diesparesan kata tas choras tes ioudaias kai samareias plen ton apostolon
sunekomisan de ton stephanon andres eulabeis kai epoiesan kopeton megan ep auto
saulos de elumaineto ten ekklesian kata tous oikous eisporeuomenos suron te andras kai gunaikas paredidou eis phulaken
hoi men oun diasparentes dielthon euanelizomenoi ton logon
philippos de katelthon eis ten polin tes samareias ekerussen autois ton christon
proseichon de hoi ochloi tois legomenois hupo tou philippou homothumadon en to akouein autous kai blepein ta semeia ha epoiei
polloi gar ton echonton pneumata akatharta boonta phone megale exerchonto polloi de paralelumenoi kai choloi etherapeuthesan
egeneto de polle chara en te polei ekeine
aner de tis onomati simon prouperchen en te polei mageuon kai existanon to ethnos tes samareias legon einai tina heauton megan
ho proseichon pantes apo mikrou heos megalou legontes houtos estin he dunamis tou theou he kaloumene megale
proseichon de auto dia to hikano chrono tais mageiais exestakenai autous
hote de episteusan to philippo euanelizomeno peri tes basileias tou theou kai tou onomatos iesou christou ebaptizonto andres te kai gunaikes
ho de simon kai autos episteusen kai baptistheis en proskarteron to philippo theoron te semeia kai dunameis megalas ginomenas existato
akousantes de hoi en hierosolumois apostoloi hoti dedektai he samareia ton logon tou theou apesteilan pros autous petron kai ioannen
hoitines katabantes proseuxanto peri auton hopos labosin pneuma hagion
oudepo gar en ep oudeni auton epipeptokos monon de bebaptismenoi huperchon eis to onoma tou kuriou iesou
tote epetithesan tas cheiras ep autous kai elambanon pneuma hagion
idon de ho simon hoti dia tes epitheseos ton cheiron ton apostolon didotai to pneuma prosenenken autois chremata
legon dote kamoi ten exousian tauten hina ho ean epitho tas cheiras lambane pneuma hagion
petros de eipen pros auton to argurion sou sun soi eie eis apoleian hoti ten dorean tou theou enomisas dia chrematon ktasthai
ouk estin soi meris oude kleros en to logo touto he gar kardia sou ouk estin eutheia enanti tou theou
metanoeson oun apo tes kakias sou tautes kai deetheti tou kuriou ei ara aphethesetai soi he epinoia tes kardias sou
eis gar cholen pikrias kai sundesmon adikias horo se onta
apokritheis de ho simon eipen deethete humeis huper emou pros ton kurion hopos meden epelthe ep eme hon eirekate
hoi men oun diamarturamenoi kai lalesantes ton logon tou kuriou hupestrephon eis hierosoluma pollas te komas ton samariton euenelizonto
anelos de kuriou elalesen pros philippon legon anastethi kai poreuou kata mesembrian epi ten hodon ten katabainousan apo ierousalem eis gazan haute estin eremos
kai anastas eporeuthe kai idou aner aithiops eunouchos dunastes kandakes basilisses aithiopon hos en epi pases tes gazes autes hos eleluthei proskuneson eis ierousalem
en te hupostrephon kai kathemenos epi tou harmatos autou kai aneginosken ton propheten esaian
eipen de to pneuma to philippo proselthe kai kolletheti to harmati touto
prosdramon de ho philippos ekousen autou anaginoskontos esaian ton propheten kai eipen ara ge ginoskeis ha anaginoskeis
ho de eipen pos gar an dunaimen ean me tis hodegesei me parekalesen te ton philippon anabanta kathisai sun auto
he de perioche tes graphes hen aneginosken en haute hos probaton epi sphagen echthe kai hos amnos enantion tou keirantos auton aphonos houtos ouk anoigei to stoma autou
en te tapeinosei autou he krisis autou erthe ten genean autou tis diegesetai hoti airetai apo tes ges he zoe autou
apokritheis de ho eunouchos to philippo eipen deomai sou peri tinos ho prophetes legei touto peri heautou e peri heterou tinos
anoixas de ho philippos to stoma autou kai arxamenos apo tes graphes tautes euenelisato auto ton iesoun
hos de eporeuonto kata ten hodon elthon epi ti hudor kai phesin ho eunouchos idou hudor ti koluei me baptisthenai
kai ekeleusen stenai to harma kai katebesan amphoteroi eis to hudor ho te philippos kai ho eunouchos kai ebaptisen auton
hote de anebesan ek tou hudatos pneuma kuriou herpasen ton philippon kai ouk eiden auton ouketi ho eunouchos eporeueto gar ten hodon autou chairon
philippos de heurethe eis azoton kai dierchomenos euenelizeto tas poleis pasas heos tou elthein auton eis kaisareian
ho de saulos eti empneon apeiles kai phonou eis tous mathetas tou kuriou proselthon to archierei
etesato par autou epistolas eis damaskon pros tas sunagogas hopos ean tinas heure tes hodou ontas andras te kai gunaikas dedemenous agage eis ierousalem
en de to poreuesthai egeneto auton enizein te damasko exaiphnes te auton periestrapsen phos ek tou ouranou
kai peson epi ten gen ekousen phonen legousan auto saoul saoul ti me diokeis
eipen de tis ei kurie ho de ego eimi iesous hon su diokeis
alla anastethi kai eiselthe eis ten polin kai lalethesetai soi ho ti se dei poiein
hoi de andres hoi sunodeuontes auto heistekeisan eneoi akouontes men tes phones medena de theorountes
egerthe de saulos apo tes ges aneogmenon de ton ophthalmon autou ouden eblepen cheiragogountes de auton eisegagon eis damaskon
kai en hemeras treis me blepon kai ouk ephagen oude epien
en de tis mathetes en damasko onomati hananias kai eipen pros auton en horamati ho kurios hanania ho de eipen idou ego kurie
ho de kurios pros auton anastas poreutheti epi ten hrumen ten kaloumenen eutheian kai zeteson en oikia iouda saulon onomati tarsea idou gar proseuchetai
kai eiden andra en horamati hananian onomati eiselthonta kai epithenta auto tas cheiras hopos anablepse
apekrithe de hananias kurie ekousa apo pollon peri tou andros toutou hosa kaka tois hagiois sou epoiesen en ierousalem
kai hode echei exousian para ton archiereon desai pantas tous epikaloumenous to onoma sou
eipen de pros auton ho kurios poreuou hoti skeuos ekloges estin moi houtos tou bastasai to onoma mou enopion ethnon te kai basileon huion te israel
ego gar hupodeixo auto hosa dei auton huper tou onomatos mou pathein

apelthen de hananias kai eiselthen eis ten oikian kai epitheis ep auton tas cheiras eipen saoul adelphe ho kurios apestalken me iesous ho ophtheis soi en te hodo he erchou hopos anablepses kai plesthes pneumatos hagiou
kai eutheos apepesan autou apo ton ophthalmon hos lepides aneblepsen te kai anastas ebaptisthe
kai labon trophen enischusen egeneto de meta ton en damasko matheton hemeras tinas
kai eutheos en tais sunagogais ekerussen ton iesoun hoti houtos estin ho huios tou theou

existanto de pantes hoi akouontes kai elegon ouch houtos estin ho porthesas eis ierousalem tous epikaloumenous to onoma touto kai hode eis touto eleluthei hina dedemenous autous agage epi tous archiereis
saulos de mallon enedunamouto kai sunechunnen tous ioudaious tous katoikountas en damasko sumbibazon hoti houtos estin ho christos
hos de eplerounto hemerai hikanai sunebouleusanto hoi ioudaioi anelein auton
egnosthe de to saulo he epiboule auton pareterounto de kai tas pulas hemeras te kai nuktos hopos auton anelosin
labontes de hoi mathetai autou nuktos dia tou teichous kathekan auton chalasantes en spuridi
paragenomenos de eis ierousalem epeirazen kollasthai tois mathetais kai pantes ephobounto auton me pisteuontes hoti estin mathetes
barnabas de epilabomenos auton egagen pros tous apostolous kai diegesato autois pos en te hodo eiden ton kurion kai hoti elalesen auto kai pos en damasko eparresiasato en to onomati tou iesou
kai en met auton eisporeuomenos kai ekporeuomenos eis ierousalem parresiazomenos en to onomati tou kuriou
elalei te kai sunezetei pros tous hellenistas hoi de epecheiroun anelein auton
epignontes de hoi adelphoi kategagon auton eis kaisareian kai exapesteilan auton eis tarson
he men oun ekklesia kath holes tes ioudaias kai galilaias kai samareias eichen eirenen oikodomoumene kai poreuomene to phobo tou kuriou kai te paraklesei tou hagiou pneumatos eplethuneto
egeneto de petron dierchomenon dia panton katelthein kai pros tous hagious tous katoikountas ludda
heuren de ekei anthropon tina onomati ainean ex eton okto katakeimenon epi krabattou hos en paralelumenos
kai eipen auto ho petros ainea iatai se iesous christos anastethi kai stroson seauto kai eutheos aneste
kai eidan auton pantes hoi katoikountes ludda kai ton sarona hoitines epestrepsan epi ton kurion
en ioppe de tis en mathetria onomati tabitha he diermeneuomene legetai dorkas haute en pleres ergon agathon kai eleemosunon hon epoiei
egeneto de en tais hemerais ekeinais asthenesasan auten apothanein lousantes de ethekan auten en huperoo
enus de ouses luddas te ioppe hoi mathetai akousantes hoti petros estin en aute apesteilan duo andras pros auton parakalountes me okneses dielthein heos hemon

anastas de petros sunelthen autois hon paragenomenon anegagon eis to huperoon kai parestesan auto pasai hai cherai klaiousai kai epideiknumenai chitonas kai himatia hosa epoiei met auton ousa he dorkas
ekbalon de exo pantas ho petros kai theis ta gonata proseuxato kai epistrepsas pros to soma eipen tabitha anastethi he de enoixen tous ophthalmous autes kai idousa ton petron anekathisen
dous de aute cheira anestesen auten phonesas de tous hagious kai tas cheras parestesen auten zosan
gnoston de egeneto kath holes tes ioppes kai episteusan polloi epi ton kurion
egeneto de hemeras hikanas meinai en ioppe para tini simoni bursei
aner de tis en kaisareia onomati kornelios hekatontarches ek speires tes kaloumenes italikes
eusebes kai phoboumenos ton theon sun panti to oiko autou poion eleemosunas pollas to lao kai deomenos tou theou dia pantos
eiden en horamati phaneros hosei peri horan enaten tes hemeras anelon tou theou eiselthonta pros auton kai eiponta auto kornelie
ho de atenisas auto kai emphobos genomenos eipen ti estin kurie eipen de auto hai proseuchai sou kai hai eleemosunai sou anebesan eis mnemosunon emprosthen tou theou
kai nun pempson andras eis ioppen kai metapempsai simona tina hos epikaleitai petros
houtos xenizetai para tini simoni bursei ho estin oikia para thalassan
hos de apelthen ho anelos ho lalon auto phonesas duo ton oiketon kai stratioten eusebe ton proskarterounton auto
kai exegesamenos hapanta autois apesteilen autous eis ten ioppen
te de epaurion hodoiporounton ekeinon kai te polei enizonton anebe petros epi to doma proseuxasthai peri horan hekten
