kai he elpis hemon bebaia huper humon eidotes hoti hos koinonoi este ton pathematon houtos kai tes parakleseos
ou gar thelomen humas agnoein adelphoi huper tes thlipseos hemon tes genomenes en te asia hoti kath huperbolen huper dunamin ebarethemen hoste exaporethenai hemas kai tou zen
alla autoi en heautois to apokrima tou thanatou eschekamen hina me pepoithotes omen eph heautois all epi to theo to egeironti tous nekrous
hos ek telikoutou thanatou errusato hemas kai hrusetai eis hon elpikamen hoti kai eti hrusetai
sunupourgounton kai humon huper hemon te deesei hina ek pollon prosopon to eis hemas charisma dia pollon eucharistethe huper hemon

he gar kauchesis hemon haute estin to marturion tes suneideseos hemon hoti en hagioteti kai eilikrineia tou theou kai ouk en sophia sarkike all en chariti theou anestraphemen en to kosmo perissoteros de pros humas
ou gar alla graphomen humin all e ha anaginoskete e kai epiginoskete elpizo de hoti heos telous epignosesthe
kathos kai epegnote hemas apo merous hoti kauchema humon esmen kathaper kai humeis hemon en te hemera tou kuriou hemon iesou
kai taute te pepoithesei eboulomen proteron pros humas elthein hina deuteran charin schete
kai di humon dielthein eis makedonian kai palin apo makedonias elthein pros humas kai huph humon propemphthenai eis ten ioudaian
touto oun boulomenos meti ara te elaphria echresamen e ha bouleuomai kata sarka bouleuomai hina e par emoi to nai nai kai to ou ou
pistos de ho theos hoti ho logos hemon ho pros humas ouk estin nai kai ou
ho tou theou gar huios iesous christos ho en humin di hemon keruchtheis di emou kai silouanou kai timotheou ouk egeneto nai kai ou alla nai en auto gegonen
hosai gar epaneliai theou en auto to nai dio kai di autou to amen to theo pros doxan di hemon
ho de bebaion hemas sun humin eis christon kai chrisas hemas theos
ho kai sphragisamenos hemas kai dous ton arrabona tou pneumatos en tais kardiais hemon
ego de martura ton theon epikaloumai epi ten emen psuchen hoti pheidomenos humon ouketi elthon eis korinthon
ouch hoti kurieuomen humon tes pisteos alla sunergoi esmen tes charas humon te gar pistei hestekate
ekrina gar emauto touto to me palin en lupe pros humas elthein
ei gar ego lupo humas kai tis ho euphrainon me ei me ho lupoumenos ex emou
kai egrapsa touto auto hina me elthon lupen scho aph hon edei me chairein pepoithos epi pantas humas hoti he eme chara panton humon estin
ek gar polles thlipseos kai sunoches kardias egrapsa humin dia pollon dakruon ouch hina lupethete alla ten agapen hina gnote hen echo perissoteros eis humas
ei de tis lelupeken ouk eme lelupeken alla apo merous hina me epibaro pantas humas
hikanon to toiouto he epitimia haute he hupo ton pleionon
hoste tounantion mallon humas charisasthai kai parakalesai me pos te perissotera lupe katapothe ho toioutos
dio parakalo humas kurosai eis auton agapen
eis touto gar kai egrapsa hina gno ten dokimen humon ei eis panta hupekooi este
ho de ti charizesthe kago kai gar ego ho kecharismai ei ti kecharismai di humas en prosopo christou
hina me pleonektethomen hupo tou satana ou gar autou ta noemata agnooumen
elthon de eis ten troada eis to euanelion tou christou kai thuras moi aneogmenes en kurio
ouk escheka anesin to pneumati mou to me heurein me titon ton adelphon mou alla apotaxamenos autois exelthon eis makedonian
to de theo charis to pantote thriambeuonti hemas en to christo kai ten osmen tes gnoseos autou phanerounti di hemon en panti topo
hoti christou euodia esmen to theo en tois sozomenois kai en tois apollumenois
hois men osme ek thanatou eis thanaton hois de osme ek zoes eis zoen kai pros tauta tis hikanos
ou gar esmen hos hoi polloi kapeleuontes ton logon tou theou all hos ex eilikrineias all hos ek theou katenanti theou en christo laloumen
archometha palin heautous sunistanein e me chrezomen hos tines sustatikon epistolon pros humas e ex humon
he epistole hemon humeis este engegrammene en tais kardiais hemon ginoskomene kai anaginoskomene hupo panton anthropon
phaneroumenoi hoti este epistole christou diakonetheisa huph hemon engegrammene ou melani alla pneumati theou zontos ouk en plaxin lithinais all en plaxin kardiais sarkinais
pepoithesin de toiauten echomen dia tou christou pros ton theon
ouch hoti aph heauton hikanoi esmen logisasthai ti hos ex heauton all he hikanotes hemon ek tou theou
hos kai hikanosen hemas diakonous kaines diathekes ou grammatos alla pneumatos to gar gramma apoktennei to de pneuma zoopoiei

ei de he diakonia tou thanatou en grammasin entetupomene lithois egenethe en doxe hoste me dunasthai atenisai tous huious israel eis to prosopon mouseos dia ten doxan tou prosopou autou ten katargoumenen
pos ouchi mallon he diakonia tou pneumatos estai en doxe
ei gar te diakonia tes katakriseos doxa pollo mallon perisseuei he diakonia tes dikaiosunes doxe
kai gar ou dedoxastai to dedoxasmenon en touto to merei heineken tes huperballouses doxes
ei gar to katargoumenon dia doxes pollo mallon to menon en doxe
echontes oun toiauten elpida polle parresia chrometha
kai ou kathaper mouses etithei kalumma epi to prosopon autou pros to me atenisai tous huious israel eis to telos tou katargoumenou
alla eporothe ta noemata auton achri gar tes semeron hemeras to auto kalumma epi te anagnosei tes palaias diathekes menei me anakaluptomenon hoti en christo katargeitai
all heos semeron henika an anaginosketai mouses kalumma epi ten kardian auton keitai
henika de ean epistrepse pros kurion periaireitai to kalumma
ho de kurios to pneuma estin hou de to pneuma kuriou eleutheria
hemeis de pantes anakekalummeno prosopo ten doxan kuriou katoptrizomenoi ten auten eikona metamorphoumetha apo doxes eis doxan kathaper apo kuriou pneumatos
dia touto echontes ten diakonian tauten kathos eleethemen ouk enkakoumen

alla apeipametha ta krupta tes aischunes me peripatountes en panourgia mede dolountes ton logon tou theou alla te phanerosei tes aletheias sunistanontes heautous pros pasan suneidesin anthropon enopion tou theou
ei de kai estin kekalummenon to euanelion hemon en tois apollumenois estin kekalummenon
en hois ho theos tou aionos toutou etuphlosen ta noemata ton apiston eis to me augasai ton photismon tou euaneliou tes doxes tou christou hos estin eikon tou theou
ou gar heautous kerussomen alla iesoun christon kurion heautous de doulous humon dia iesoun
hoti ho theos ho eipon ek skotous phos lampsei hos elampsen en tais kardiais hemon pros photismon tes gnoseos tes doxes tou theou en prosopo iesou christou
echomen de ton thesauron touton en ostrakinois skeuesin hina he huperbole tes dunameos e tou theou kai me ex hemon
en panti thlibomenoi all ou stenochoroumenoi aporoumenoi all ouk exaporoumenoi
diokomenoi all ouk enkataleipomenoi kataballomenoi all ouk apollumenoi
pantote ten nekrosin tou iesou en to somati peripherontes hina kai he zoe tou iesou en to somati hemon phanerothe
aei gar hemeis hoi zontes eis thanaton paradidometha dia iesoun hina kai he zoe tou iesou phanerothe en te thnete sarki hemon
hoste ho thanatos en hemin energeitai he de zoe en humin
echontes de to auto pneuma tes pisteos kata to gegrammenon episteusa dio elalesa kai hemeis pisteuomen dio kai laloumen
eidotes hoti ho egeiras ton kurion iesoun kai hemas sun iesou egerei kai parastesei sun humin
ta gar panta di humas hina he charis pleonasasa dia ton pleionon ten eucharistian perisseuse eis ten doxan tou theou
dio ouk enkakoumen all ei kai ho exo hemon anthropos diaphtheiretai all ho eso hemon anakainoutai hemera kai hemera
to gar parautika elaphron tes thlipseos hemon kath huperbolen eis huperbolen aionion baros doxes katergazetai hemin
me skopounton hemon ta blepomena alla ta me blepomena ta gar blepomena proskaira ta de me blepomena aionia
oidamen gar hoti ean he epigeios hemon oikia tou skenous kataluthe oikodomen ek theou echomen oikian acheiropoieton aionion en tois ouranois
kai gar en touto stenazomen to oiketerion hemon to ex ouranou ependusasthai epipothountes
ei ge kai endusamenoi ou gumnoi heurethesometha
kai gar hoi ontes en to skenei stenazomen baroumenoi eph ho ou thelomen ekdusasthai all ependusasthai hina katapothe to thneton hupo tes zoes
ho de katergasamenos hemas eis auto touto theos ho dous hemin ton arrabona tou pneumatos
tharrountes oun pantote kai eidotes hoti endemountes en to somati ekdemoumen apo tou kuriou
dia pisteos gar peripatoumen ou dia eidous
tharroumen de kai eudokoumen mallon ekdemesai ek tou somatos kai endemesai pros ton kurion
dio kai philotimoumetha eite endemountes eite ekdemountes euarestoi auto einai
tous gar pantas hemas phanerothenai dei emprosthen tou bematos tou christou hina komisetai hekastos ta dia tou somatos pros ha epraxen eite agathon eite phaulon
eidotes oun ton phobon tou kuriou anthropous peithomen theo de pephanerometha elpizo de kai en tais suneidesesin humon pephanerosthai
ou palin heautous sunistanomen humin alla aphormen didontes humin kauchematos huper hemon hina echete pros tous en prosopo kauchomenous kai me en kardia
eite gar exestemen theo eite sophronoumen humin
he gar agape tou christou sunechei hemas krinantas touto hoti heis huper panton apethanen ara hoi pantes apethanon
kai huper panton apethanen hina hoi zontes meketi heautois zosin alla to huper auton apothanonti kai egerthenti
hoste hemeis apo tou nun oudena oidamen kata sarka ei kai egnokamen kata sarka christon alla nun ouketi ginoskomen
hoste ei tis en christo kaine ktisis ta archaia parelthen idou gegonen kaina
ta de panta ek tou theou tou katallaxantos hemas heauto dia christou kai dontos hemin ten diakonian tes katallages
hos hoti theos en en christo kosmon katallasson heauto me logizomenos autois ta paraptomata auton kai themenos en hemin ton logon tes katallages
huper christou oun presbeuomen hos tou theou parakalountos di hemon deometha huper christou katallagete to theo
ton me gnonta hamartian huper hemon hamartian epoiesen hina hemeis genometha dikaiosune theou en auto
sunergountes de kai parakaloumen me eis kenon ten charin tou theou dexasthai humas
legei gar kairo dekto epekousa sou kai en hemera soterias eboethesa soi idou nun kairos euprosdektos idou nun hemera soterias
medemian en medeni didontes proskopen hina me momethe he diakonia
all en panti sunistantes heautous hos theou diakonoi en hupomone polle en thlipsesin en anankais en stenochoriais
en plegais en phulakais en akatastasiais en kopois en agrupniais en nesteiais
en hagnoteti en gnosei en makrothumia en chrestoteti en pneumati hagio en agape anupokrito
en logo aletheias en dunamei theou dia ton hoplon tes dikaiosunes ton dexion kai aristeron
dia doxes kai atimias dia dusphemias kai euphemias hos planoi kai aletheis
hos agnooumenoi kai epiginoskomenoi hos apothneskontes kai idou zomen hos paideuomenoi kai me thanatoumenoi
hos lupoumenoi aei de chairontes hos ptochoi pollous de ploutizontes hos meden echontes kai panta katechontes
to stoma hemon aneogen pros humas korinthioi he kardia hemon peplatuntai
ou stenochoreisthe en hemin stenochoreisthe de en tois splanchnois humon
ten de auten antimisthian hos teknois lego platunthete kai humeis
me ginesthe heterozugountes apistois tis gar metoche dikaiosune kai anomia e tis koinonia photi pros skotos
tis de sumphonesis christou pros beliar e tis meris pisto meta apistou
tis de sunkatathesis nao theou meta eidolon hemeis gar naos theou esmen zontos kathos eipen ho theos hoti enoikeso en autois kai emperipateso kai esomai auton theos kai autoi esontai mou laos
dio exelthate ek mesou auton kai aphoristhete legei kurios kai akathartou me haptesthe kago eisdexomai humas
kai esomai humin eis patera kai humeis esesthe moi eis huious kai thugateras legei kurios pantokrator
tautas oun echontes tas epanelias agapetoi katharisomen heautous apo pantos molusmou sarkos kai pneumatos epitelountes hagiosunen en phobo theou
choresate hemas oudena edikesamen oudena ephtheiramen oudena epleonektesamen
pros katakrisin ou lego proeireka gar hoti en tais kardiais hemon este eis to sunapothanein kai suzen
polle moi parresia pros humas polle moi kauchesis huper humon pepleromai te paraklesei huperperisseuomai te chara epi pase te thlipsei hemon
kai gar elthonton hemon eis makedonian oudemian escheken anesin he sarx hemon all en panti thlibomenoi exothen machai esothen phoboi
all ho parakalon tous tapeinous parekalesen hemas ho theos en te parousia titou
ou monon de en te parousia autou alla kai en te paraklesei he pareklethe eph humin ananellon hemin ten humon epipothesin ton humon odurmon ton humon zelon huper emou hoste me mallon charenai
hoti ei kai elupesa humas en te epistole ou metamelomai ei kai metemelomen blepo gar hoti he epistole ekeine ei kai pros horan elupesen humas
nun chairo ouch hoti elupethete all hoti elupethete eis metanoian elupethete gar kata theon hina en medeni zemiothete ex hemon
he gar kata theon lupe metanoian eis soterian ametameleton ergazetai he de tou kosmou lupe thanaton katergazetai

idou gar auto touto to kata theon lupethenai posen kateirgasato humin spouden alla apologian alla aganaktesin alla phobon alla epipothesin alla zelon alla ekdikesin en panti sunestesate heautous hagnous einai to pragmati
ara ei kai egrapsa humin ouch heneken tou adikesantos oude heneken tou adikethentos all heneken tou phanerothenai ten spouden humon ten huper hemon pros humas enopion tou theou
dia touto parakeklemetha epi de te paraklesei hemon perissoteros mallon echaremen epi te chara titou hoti anapepautai to pneuma autou apo panton humon
hoti ei ti auto huper humon kekauchemai ou kateschunthen all hos panta en aletheia elalesamen humin houtos kai he kauchesis hemon he epi titou aletheia egenethe
kai ta splanchna autou perissoteros eis humas estin anamimneskomenou ten panton humon hupakoen hos meta phobou kai tromou edexasthe auton
chairo hoti en panti tharro en humin
gnorizomen de humin adelphoi ten charin tou theou ten dedomenen en tais ekklesiais tes makedonias
hoti en polle dokime thlipseos he perisseia tes charas auton kai he kata bathous ptocheia auton eperisseusen eis to ploutos tes haplotetos auton
hoti kata dunamin marturo kai para dunamin authairetoi
meta polles parakleseos deomenoi hemon ten charin kai ten koinonian tes diakonias tes eis tous hagious
kai ou kathos elpisamen all heautous edokan proton to kurio kai hemin dia thelematos theou
eis to parakalesai hemas titon hina kathos proenerxato houtos kai epitelese eis humas kai ten charin tauten
all hosper en panti perisseuete pistei kai logo kai gnosei kai pase spoude kai te ex hemon en humin agape hina kai en taute te chariti perisseuete
ou kat epitagen lego alla dia tes heteron spoudes kai to tes humeteras agapes gnesion dokimazon
ginoskete gar ten charin tou kuriou hemon iesou christou hoti di humas eptocheusen plousios on hina humeis te ekeinou ptocheia ploutesete
kai gnomen en touto didomi touto gar humin sumpherei hoitines ou monon to poiesai alla kai to thelein proenerxasthe apo perusi
nuni de kai to poiesai epitelesate hopos kathaper he prothumia tou thelein houtos kai to epitelesai ek tou echein
ei gar he prothumia prokeitai katho ean eche euprosdektos ou katho ouk echei
ou gar hina allois anesis humin thlipsis all ex isotetos
en to nun kairo to humon perisseuma eis to ekeinon husterema hina kai to ekeinon perisseuma genetai eis to humon husterema hopos genetai isotes
kathos gegraptai ho to polu ouk epleonasen kai ho to oligon ouk elattonesen
charis de to theo to didonti ten auten spouden huper humon en te kardia titou
hoti ten men paraklesin edexato spoudaioteros de huparchon authairetos exelthen pros humas
sunepempsamen de met autou ton adelphon hou ho epainos en to euanelio dia pason ton ekklesion
ou monon de alla kai cheirotonetheis hupo ton ekklesion sunekdemos hemon sun te chariti taute te diakonoumene huph hemon pros ten autou tou kuriou doxan kai prothumian hemon
stellomenoi touto me tis hemas momesetai en te hadroteti taute te diakonoumene huph hemon
pronooumen gar kala ou monon enopion kuriou alla kai enopion anthropon
sunepempsamen de autois ton adelphon hemon hon edokimasamen en pollois pollakis spoudaion onta nuni de polu spoudaioteron pepoithesei polle te eis humas
eite huper titou koinonos emos kai eis humas sunergos eite adelphoi hemon apostoloi ekklesion doxa christou
ten oun endeixin tes agapes humon kai hemon kaucheseos huper humon eis autous endeiknumenoi eis prosopon ton ekklesion
peri men gar tes diakonias tes eis tous hagious perisson moi estin to graphein humin
oida gar ten prothumian humon hen huper humon kauchomai makedosin hoti achaia pareskeuastai apo perusi kai to humon zelos erethisen tous pleionas
epempsa de tous adelphous hina me to kauchema hemon to huper humon kenothe en to merei touto hina kathos elegon pareskeuasmenoi ete
me pos ean elthosin sun emoi makedones kai heurosin humas aparaskeuastous kataischunthomen hemeis hina me legomen humeis en te hupostasei taute
anankaion oun hegesamen parakalesai tous adelphous hina proelthosin eis humas kai prokatartisosin ten proepenelmenen eulogian humon tauten hetoimen einai houtos hos eulogian kai me hos pleonexian
touto de ho speiron pheidomenos pheidomenos kai therisei kai ho speiron ep eulogiais ep eulogiais kai therisei
hekastos kathos proeretai te kardia me ek lupes e ex anankes hilaron gar doten agapa ho theos
dunatei de ho theos pasan charin perisseusai eis humas hina en panti pantote pasan autarkeian echontes perisseuete eis pan ergon agathon
kathos gegraptai eskorpisen edoken tois penesin he dikaiosune autou menei eis ton aiona
ho de epichoregon sporon to speironti kai arton eis brosin choregesei kai plethunei ton sporon humon kai auxesei ta genemata tes dikaiosunes humon
en panti ploutizomenoi eis pasan haploteta hetis katergazetai di hemon eucharistian to theo
hoti he diakonia tes leitourgias tautes ou monon estin prosanaplerousa ta husteremata ton hagion alla kai perisseuousa dia pollon eucharistion to theo
dia tes dokimes tes diakonias tautes doxazontes ton theon epi te hupotage tes homologias humon eis to euanelion tou christou kai haploteti tes koinonias eis autous kai eis pantas
kai auton deesei huper humon epipothounton humas dia ten huperballousan charin tou theou eph humin
charis to theo epi te anekdiegeto autou dorea
autos de ego paulos parakalo humas dia tes prautetos kai epieikeias tou christou hos kata prosopon men tapeinos en humin apon de tharro eis humas
deomai de to me paron tharresai te pepoithesei he logizomai tolmesai epi tinas tous logizomenous hemas hos kata sarka peripatountas
en sarki gar peripatountes ou kata sarka strateuometha
ta gar hopla tes strateias hemon ou sarkika alla dunata to theo pros kathairesin ochuromaton logismous kathairountes
kai pan hupsoma epairomenon kata tes gnoseos tou theou kai aichmalotizontes pan noema eis ten hupakoen tou christou

hoti hai epistolai men phesin bareiai kai ischurai he de parousia tou somatos asthenes kai ho logos exouthenemenos

ho de kauchomenos en kurio kauchastho

kai paron pros humas kai husteretheis ou katenarkesa outhenos to gar husterema mou prosaneplerosan hoi adelphoi elthontes apo makedonias kai en panti abare emauton humin eteresa kai tereso
estin aletheia christou en emoi hoti he kauchesis haute ou phragesetai eis eme en tois klimasin tes achaias
dia ti hoti ouk agapo humas ho theos oiden
ho de poio kai poieso hina ekkopso ten aphormen ton thelonton aphormen hina en ho kauchontai heurethosin kathos kai hemeis

eucharistein opheilomen to theo pantote peri humon adelphoi kathos axion estin hoti huperauxanei he pistis humon kai pleonazei he agape henos hekastou panton humon eis allelous
hoste autous hemas en humin enkauchasthai en tais ekklesiais tou theou huper tes hupomones humon kai pisteos en pasin tois diogmois humon kai tais thlipsesin hais anechesthe
endeigma tes dikaias kriseos tou theou eis to kataxiothenai humas tes basileias tou theou huper hes kai paschete

ho antikeimenos kai huperairomenos epi panta legomenon theon e sebasma hoste auton eis ton naon tou theou kathisai apodeiknunta heauton hoti estin theos
ou mnemoneuete hoti eti on pros humas tauta elegon humin

hina artios e ho tou theou anthropos pros pan ergon agathon exertismenos
diamarturomai enopion tou theou kai christou iesou tou mellontos krinein zontas kai nekrous kai ten epiphaneian autou kai ten basileian autou
keruxon ton logon epistethi eukairos akairos elegxon epitimeson parakaleson en pase makrothumia kai didache
estai gar kairos hote tes hugiainouses didaskalias ouk anexontai alla kata tas idias epithumias heautois episoreusousin didaskalous knethomenoi ten akoen
kai apo men tes aletheias ten akoen apostrepsousin epi de tous muthous ektrapesontai
su de nephe en pasin kakopatheson ergon poieson euanelistou ten diakonian sou plerophoreson
ego gar ede spendomai kai ho kairos tes analuseos mou ephesteken
ton kalon agona egonismai ton dromon teteleka ten pistin tetereka
loipon apokeitai moi ho tes dikaiosunes stephanos hon apodosei moi ho kurios en ekeine te hemera ho dikaios krites ou monon de emoi alla kai pasi tois egapekosi ten epiphaneian autou
spoudason elthein pros me tacheos
demas gar me enkatelipen agapesas ton nun aiona kai eporeuthe eis thessaloniken kreskes eis galatian titos eis dalmatian
loukas estin monos met emou markon analabon age meta seautou estin gar moi euchrestos eis diakonian
tuchikon de apesteila eis epheson
ton phailonen hon apelipon en troadi para karpo erchomenos phere kai ta biblia malista tas membranas
alexandros ho chalkeus polla moi kaka enedeixato apodosei auto ho kurios kata ta erga autou
hon kai su phulassou lian gar anteste tois hemeterois logois
en te prote mou apologia oudeis moi paregeneto alla pantes me enkatelipon me autois logistheie
ho de kurios moi pareste kai enedunamosen me hina di emou to kerugma plerophorethe kai akousosin panta ta ethne kai errusthen ek stomatos leontos
hrusetai me ho kurios apo pantos ergou ponerou kai sosei eis ten basileian autou ten epouranion ho he doxa eis tous aionas ton aionon amen
aspasai priskan kai akulan kai ton onesiphorou oikon
erastos emeinen en korintho trophimon de apelipon en mileto asthenounta
spoudason pro cheimonos elthein aspazetai se euboulos kai poudes kai linos kai klaudia kai hoi adelphoi pantes
ho kurios meta tou pneumatos sou he charis meth humon
Titus: paulos doulos theou apostolos de iesou christou kata pistin eklekton theou kai epignosin aletheias tes kat eusebeian
ep elpidi zoes aioniou hen epeneilato ho apseudes theos pro chronon aionion
ephanerosen de kairois idiois ton logon autou en kerugmati ho episteuthen ego kat epitagen tou soteros hemon theou
tito gnesio tekno kata koinen pistin charis kai eirene apo theou patros kai christou iesou tou soteros hemon
toutou charin apelipon se en krete hina ta leiponta epidiorthose kai katasteses kata polin presbuterous hos ego soi dietaxamen
ei tis estin anenkletos mias gunaikos aner tekna echon pista me en kategoria asotias e anupotakta
dei gar ton episkopon anenkleton einai hos theou oikonomon me authade me orgilon me paroinon me plekten me aischrokerde
alla philoxenon philagathon sophrona dikaion hosion enkrate
antechomenon tou kata ten didachen pistou logou hina dunatos e kai parakalein en te didaskalia te hugiainouse kai tous antilegontas elenchein
eisin gar polloi kai anupotaktoi mataiologoi kai phrenapatai malista hoi ek tes peritomes
hous dei epistomizein hoitines holous oikous anatrepousin didaskontes ha me dei aischrou kerdous charin
eipen tis ex auton idios auton prophetes kretes aei pseustai kaka theria gasteres argai
he marturia haute estin alethes di hen aitian elenche autous apotomos hina hugiainosin en te pistei
me prosechontes ioudaikois muthois kai entolais anthropon apostrephomenon ten aletheian
panta kathara tois katharois tois de memiammenois kai apistois ouden katharon alla memiantai auton kai ho nous kai he suneidesis
theon homologousin eidenai tois de ergois arnountai bdeluktoi ontes kai apeitheis kai pros pan ergon agathon adokimoi
su de lalei ha prepei te hugiainouse didaskalia
presbutas nephalious einai semnous sophronas hugiainontas te pistei te agape te hupomone
presbutidas hosautos en katastemati hieroprepeis me diabolous mede oino pollo dedoulomenas kalodidaskalous
hina sophronizosin tas neas philandrous einai philoteknous
sophronas hagnas oikourgous agathas hupotassomenas tois idiois andrasin hina me ho logos tou theou blasphemetai
tous neoterous hosautos parakalei sophronein
peri panta seauton parechomenos tupon kalon ergon en te didaskalia aphthorian semnoteta
logon hugie akatagnoston hina ho ex enantias entrape meden echon legein peri hemon phaulon
doulous idiois despotais hupotassesthai en pasin euarestous einai me antilegontas
me nosphizomenous alla pasan pistin endeiknumenous agathen hina ten didaskalian ten tou soteros hemon theou kosmosin en pasin
epephane gar he charis tou theou soterios pasin anthropois
paideuousa hemas hina arnesamenoi ten asebeian kai tas kosmikas epithumias sophronos kai dikaios kai eusebos zesomen en to nun aioni
prosdechomenoi ten makarian elpida kai epiphaneian tes doxes tou megalou theou kai soteros hemon iesou christou
hos edoken heauton huper hemon hina lutrosetai hemas apo pases anomias kai katharise heauto laon periousion zeloten kalon ergon
tauta lalei kai parakalei kai elenche meta pases epitages medeis sou periphroneito
hupomimneske autous archais exousiais hupotassesthai peitharchein pros pan ergon agathon hetoimous einai
medena blasphemein amachous einai epieikeis pasan endeiknumenous prauteta pros pantas anthropous
emen gar pote kai hemeis anoetoi apeitheis planomenoi douleuontes epithumiais kai hedonais poikilais en kakia kai phthono diagontes stugetoi misountes allelous
hote de he chrestotes kai he philanthropia epephane tou soteros hemon theou
ouk ex ergon ton en dikaiosune ha epoiesamen hemeis alla kata to autou eleos esosen hemas dia loutrou palingenesias kai anakainoseos pneumatos hagiou
hou execheen eph hemas plousios dia iesou christou tou soteros hemon
hina dikaiothentes te ekeinou chariti kleronomoi genethomen kat elpida zoes aioniou
pistos ho logos kai peri touton boulomai se diabebaiousthai hina phrontizosin kalon ergon proistasthai hoi pepisteukotes theo tauta estin kala kai ophelima tois anthropois
moras de zeteseis kai genealogias kai ereis kai machas nomikas periistaso eisin gar anopheleis kai mataioi
hairetikon anthropon meta mian kai deuteran nouthesian paraitou
eidos hoti exestraptai ho toioutos kai hamartanei on autokatakritos
hotan pempso arteman pros se e tuchikon spoudason elthein pros me eis nikopolin ekei gar kekrika paracheimasai
zenan ton nomikon kai apollon spoudaios propempson hina meden autois leipe
manthanetosan de kai hoi hemeteroi kalon ergon proistasthai eis tas anankaias chreias hina me osin akarpoi
aspazontai se hoi met emou pantes aspasai tous philountas hemas en pistei he charis meta panton humon
Philemon: paulos desmios christou iesou kai timotheos ho adelphos philemoni to agapeto kai sunergo hemon
kai apphia te adelphe kai archippo to sustratiote hemon kai te kat oikon sou ekklesia
charis humin kai eirene apo theou patros hemon kai kuriou iesou christou
eucharisto to theo mou pantote mneian sou poioumenos epi ton proseuchon mou
akouon sou ten agapen kai ten pistin hen echeis pros ton kurion iesoun kai eis pantas tous hagious
hopos he koinonia tes pisteos sou energes genetai en epignosei pantos agathou tou en hemin eis christon
charan gar pollen eschon kai paraklesin epi te agape sou hoti ta splanchna ton hagion anapepautai dia sou adelphe
dio pollen en christo parresian echon epitassein soi to anekon
dia ten agapen mallon parakalo toioutos on hos paulos presbutes nuni de kai desmios christou iesou
parakalo se peri tou emou teknou hon egennesa en tois desmois onesimon
ton pote soi achreston nuni de kai soi kai emoi euchreston
hon anepempsa soi auton tout estin ta ema splanchna
hon ego eboulomen pros emauton katechein hina huper sou moi diakone en tois desmois tou euaneliou
choris de tes ses gnomes ouden ethelesa poiesai hina me hos kata ananken to agathon sou e alla kata hekousion
tacha gar dia touto echoristhe pros horan hina aionion auton apeches
ouketi hos doulon alla huper doulon adelphon agapeton malista emoi poso de mallon soi kai en sarki kai en kurio
ei oun me echeis koinonon proslabou auton hos eme
ei de ti edikesen se e opheilei touto emoi elloga
ego paulos egrapsa te eme cheiri ego apotiso hina me lego soi hoti kai seauton moi prosopheileis
nai adelphe ego sou onaimen en kurio anapauson mou ta splanchna en christo
pepoithos te hupakoe sou egrapsa soi eidos hoti kai huper ha lego poieseis
hama de kai hetoimaze moi xenian elpizo gar hoti dia ton proseuchon humon charisthesomai humin
aspazetai se epaphras ho sunaichmalotos mou en christo iesou
markos aristarchos demas loukas hoi sunergoi mou
he charis tou kuriou iesou christou meta tou pneumatos humon
Hebrews: polumeros kai polutropos palai ho theos lalesas tois patrasin en tois prophetais
ep eschatou ton hemeron touton elalesen hemin en huio hon etheken kleronomon panton di hou kai epoiesen tous aionas
hos on apaugasma tes doxes kai charakter tes hupostaseos autou pheron te ta panta to hremati tes dunameos autou katharismon ton hamartion poiesamenos ekathisen en dexia tes megalosunes en hupselois
tosouto kreitton genomenos ton anelon hoso diaphoroteron par autous kekleronomeken onoma
tini gar eipen pote ton anelon huios mou ei su ego semeron gegenneka se kai palin ego esomai auto eis patera kai autos estai moi eis huion
hotan de palin eisagage ton prototokon eis ten oikoumenen legei kai proskunesatosan auto pantes aneloi theou
kai pros men tous anelous legei ho poion tous anelous autou pneumata kai tous leitourgous autou puros phloga
pros de ton huion ho thronos sou ho theos eis ton aiona tou aionos kai he hrabdos tes euthutetos hrabdos tes basileias sou
egapesas dikaiosunen kai emisesas anomian dia touto echrisen se ho theos ho theos sou elaion agalliaseos para tous metochous sou
kai su kat archas kurie ten gen ethemeliosas kai erga ton cheiron sou eisin hoi ouranoi
autoi apolountai su de diameneis kai pantes hos himation palaiothesontai
kai hosei peribolaion helixeis autous hos himation kai allagesontai su de ho autos ei kai ta ete sou ouk ekleipsousin
pros tina de ton anelon eireken pote kathou ek dexion mou heos an tho tous echthrous sou hupopodion ton podon sou
ouchi pantes eisin leitourgika pneumata eis diakonian apostellomena dia tous mellontas kleronomein soterian
dia touto dei perissoteros prosechein hemas tois akoustheisin mepote pararuomen
ei gar ho di anelon laletheis logos egeneto bebaios kai pasa parabasis kai parakoe elaben endikon misthapodosian
pos hemeis ekpheuxometha telikautes amelesantes soterias hetis archen labousa laleisthai dia tou kuriou hupo ton akousanton eis hemas ebebaiothe
sunepimarturountos tou theou semeiois te kai terasin kai poikilais dunamesin kai pneumatos hagiou merismois kata ten autou thelesin
ou gar anelois hupetaxen ten oikoumenen ten mellousan peri hes laloumen
diemarturato de pou tis legon ti estin anthropos hoti mimneske autou e huios anthropou hoti episkepte auton
elattosas auton brachu ti par anelous doxe kai time estephanosas auton
panta hupetaxas hupokato ton podon autou en to gar hupotaxai auto ta panta ouden apheken auto anupotakton nun de oupo horomen auto ta panta hupotetagmena
ton de brachu ti par anelous elattomenon blepomen iesoun dia to pathema tou thanatou doxe kai time estephanomenon hopos chariti theou huper pantos geusetai thanatou
eprepen gar auto di hon ta panta kai di hou ta panta pollous huious eis doxan agagonta ton archegon tes soterias auton dia pathematon teleiosai
ho te gar hagiazon kai hoi hagiazomenoi ex henos pantes di hen aitian ouk epaischunetai adelphous autous kalein
legon apanelo to onoma sou tois adelphois mou en meso ekklesias humneso se
kai palin ego esomai pepoithos ep auto kai palin idou ego kai ta paidia ha moi edoken ho theos
epei oun ta paidia kekoinoneken haimatos kai sarkos kai autos paraplesios meteschen ton auton hina dia tou thanatou katargese ton to kratos echonta tou thanatou tout estin ton diabolon
kai apallaxe toutous hosoi phobo thanatou dia pantos tou zen enochoi esan douleias
ou gar depou anelon epilambanetai alla spermatos abraam epilambanetai
hothen opheilen kata panta tois adelphois homoiothenai hina eleemon genetai kai pistos archiereus ta pros ton theon eis to hilaskesthai tas hamartias tou laou
en ho gar peponthen autos peirastheis dunatai tois peirazomenois boethesai
hothen adelphoi hagioi kleseos epouraniou metochoi katanoesate ton apostolon kai archierea tes homologias hemon iesoun
piston onta to poiesanti auton hos kai mouses en holo to oiko autou
pleionos gar houtos doxes para mousen exiotai kath hoson pleiona timen echei tou oikou ho kataskeuasas auton
pas gar oikos kataskeuazetai hupo tinos ho de panta kataskeuasas theos
kai mouses men pistos en holo to oiko autou hos therapon eis marturion ton lalethesomenon
christos de hos huios epi ton oikon autou hou oikos esmen hemeis ean ten parresian kai to kauchema tes elpidos kataschomen
dio kathos legei to pneuma to hagion semeron ean tes phones autou akousete
me sklerunete tas kardias humon hos en to parapikrasmo kata ten hemeran tou peirasmou en te eremo
hou epeirasan hoi pateres humon en dokimasia kai eidon ta erga mou
tesserakonta ete dio prosochthisa te genea taute kai eipon aei planontai te kardia autoi de ouk egnosan tas hodous mou
hos omosa en te orge mou ei eiseleusontai eis ten katapausin mou
blepete adelphoi mepote estai en tini humon kardia ponera apistias en to apostenai apo theou zontos
alla parakaleite heautous kath hekasten hemeran achris hou to semeron kaleitai hina me sklerunthe tis ex humon apate tes hamartias
metochoi gar tou christou gegonamen eanper ten archen tes hupostaseos mechri telous bebaian kataschomen
en to legesthai semeron ean tes phones autou akousete me sklerunete tas kardias humon hos en to parapikrasmo

kai blepomen hoti ouk edunethesan eiselthein di apistian
phobethomen oun mepote kataleipomenes epanelias eiselthein eis ten katapausin autou doke tis ex humon husterekenai

eireken gar pou peri tes hebdomes houtos kai katepausen ho theos en te hemera te hebdome apo panton ton ergon autou

epei oun apoleipetai tinas eiselthein eis auten kai hoi proteron euanelisthentes ouk eiselthon di apeitheian

ara apoleipetai sabbatismos to lao tou theou
ho gar eiselthon eis ten katapausin autou kai autos katepausen apo ton ergon autou hosper apo ton idion ho theos

zon gar ho logos tou theou kai energes kai tomoteros huper pasan machairan distomon kai diiknoumenos achri merismou psuches kai pneumatos harmon te kai muelon kai kritikos enthumeseon kai ennoion kardias

metriopathein dunamenos tois agnoousin kai planomenois epei kai autos perikeitai astheneian

kathos kai en hetero legei su hiereus eis ton aiona kata ten taxin melchisedek

kaiper on huios emathen aph hon epathen ten hupakoen

peri hou polus hemin ho logos kai dusermeneutos legein epei nothroi gegonate tais akoais

kai gar opheilontes einai didaskaloi dia ton chronon palin chreian echete tou didaskein humas tina ta stoicheia tes arches ton logion tou theou kai gegonate chreian echontes galaktos kai ou stereas trophes

teleion de estin he sterea trophe ton dia ten hexin ta aistheteria gegumnasmena echonton pros diakrisin kalou te kai kakou

kai touto poiesomen eanper epitrepe ho theos
adunaton gar tous hapax photisthentas geusamenous te tes doreas tes epouraniou kai metochous genethentas pneumatos hagiou
kai kalon geusamenous theou hrema dunameis te mellontos aionos
kai parapesontas palin anakainizein eis metanoian anastaurountas heautois ton huion tou theou kai paradeigmatizontas
ge gar he piousa ton ep autes erchomenon pollakis hueton kai tiktousa botanen eutheton ekeinois di hous kai georgeitai metalambanei eulogias apo tou theou

pepeismetha de peri humon agapetoi ta kreissona kai echomena soterias ei kai houtos laloumen

legon ei men eulogon eulogeso se kai plethunon plethuno se
kai houtos makrothumesas epetuchen tes epanelias
anthropoi gar kata tou meizonos omnuousin kai pases autois antilogias peras eis bebaiosin ho horkos
en ho perissoteron boulomenos ho theos epideixai tois kleronomois tes epanelias to ametatheton tes boules autou emesiteusen horko

hen hos ankuran echomen tes psuches asphale te kai bebaian kai eiserchomenen eis to esoteron tou katapetasmatos

kai hode men dekatas apothneskontes anthropoi lambanousin ekei de marturoumenos hoti ze

eti gar en te osphui tou patros en hote sunentesen auto melchisedek
ei men oun teleiosis dia tes leuitikes hierosunes en ho laos gar ep autes nenomothetetai tis eti chreia kata ten taxin melchisedek heteron anistasthai hierea kai ou kata ten taxin aaron legesthai
metatithemenes gar tes hierosunes ex anankes kai nomou metathesis ginetai

hos ou kata nomon entoles sarkines gegonen alla kata dunamin zoes akatalutou

ho heorakamen kai akekoamen apanellomen kai humin hina kai humeis koinonian echete meth hemon kai he koinonia de he hemetera meta tou patros kai meta tou huiou autou iesou christou
kai tauta graphomen hemeis hina he chara hemon e pepleromene

idou erchomai hos kleptes makarios ho gregoron kai teron ta himatia autou hina me gumnos peripate kai bleposin ten aschemosunen autou

meth hes eporneusan hoi basileis tes ges kai emethusthesan hoi katoikountes ten gen ek tou oinou tes porneias autes
